subject: October Newsletter
body:
An update from the Cavaleri for Congress Campaign trail | | |
---
| |
# Cavaleri for Congress Volunteers,

Well, here we are, just five weeks left until election day. We want to thank all of you before November 8th comes around. Some of you have been with us for over 15 months now, and the finish line almost seems surreal. As we roll full steam ahead towards election day, we wanted to give one final update, so you know exactly what your efforts have meant to the campaign thus far.

First off, our first of two, potentially three commercials launched on Monday, September 26th. This will play all the way through election day, and the others will run during this same period, just earlier in the day. There were many steps that had to go right, but most importantly, you provided the resources to make the first commercial possible. We couldn't have done it without your support. Thank you, Doug Basler, for donating the film crew for the shoot.
---
| | [ ](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=a813f24ed5&e=4003acec22)
---
Check out our final ad on YouTube!
| A special shout out and heartfelt thank you to Don and Mindy Nelson for hosting our most successful fundraiser to date at Securité Gun Range in Woodinville. You guys helped make the commercial a reality.
---
|
---
|
---
---
|
---
| We have continued to doorbell throughout the First Congressional District. Our canvassers are currently in multiple locations throughout both counties and have visited thousands of homes. The reception has been great! Our friends and neighbors understand the predicament America is in; and this should translate at the ballot box. Getting the vote out is of the utmost importance, so please be sure to tell everyone you know to vote!

Our second mailer is in the final stages of editing and will go out in a matter of weeks. These are targeted to specific voters within the district and are very effective. We coordinate these to go out when the ballots are mailed.

Our team has also recently received several more boxes of signs, so if you would like one for your yard or place of business, please email us and we will plan to get it to you.

We will continue to do speaking events and fundraising events every chance we can. Our schedule is tight, but we will try to always be accommodating to schedule everyone in. If you would like to host a Cavaleri for Congress event, please contact the campaign and we will make it happen. These grassroots events are a large part of our success.
---
|
---
|
---
|
---
| Finances are essential at this point and will be the determining factor for the next two commercials. If you were planning to help the campaign financially, _now would be the time!**Please consider donating today!**_
---
| [DONATE TO THE CAMPAIGN](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=596df7d855&e=4003acec22 "DONATE TO THE CAMPAIGN")
---
| If hosting an event is not in your wheelhouse, and you would like to attend some of our future events, please check the [campaign calendar](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=dc37044732&e=4003acec22) or contact us directly. We have many exciting events to choose from. Our next dinner event will be on Wednesday, October 12th @ 6:30 PM @ Firenze Italian Restaurant, and will host a full sit-down dinner in the Bellevue location. This event is RSVP only, and will include your appetizers, entrées, drinks, and dessert. If you would like attend, please contact us to RSVP.

Thank you, Sal and Valentina, for your continued friendship and support!
---
|
---
| _**Interviews:**_ I recently had the opportunity to speak to KOMO News about my candidacy and my top issues. You can check out the video segment and article [here](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=f716088472&e=4003acec22).

_**Debates:**_ Please tune in on October 18th, at 6:30 PM to an online forum between my opponent and I. It will be hosted by The League of Women Voters (LOWV) and streamed from Sultan High School on their [YouTube channel](https://cavaleriforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=4a29b1ba509ec449e66652aec&id=06966526b0&e=4003acec22). We had hoped for a live face-to-face debate, but Zoom is currently the only platform the host could accommodate at this time. However, Braver Angels, a bipartisan nonprofit organization dedicated to bridging the partisan divide, is trying to secure a live face-to-face event the third week of October. We will keep you posted.

In closing, I want to express my heartfelt gratitude to all of you that have given your time, your talent, and your treasure. You are all heroes in my book and deserve all the accolades that go with that. America sits on the brink of turning into something it was never intended to be, and you stand in the way. That is the definition of patriotism; and I will stand shoulder to shoulder with you all the way. God bless all of you, and God bless the United States of America.
---
|
---

team@cavaleriforcongress.com

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

# One Month Until Election!
Team Hunley,

There is a lot going on - scroll all the way down for the ways that you can be a part of this exciting campaign. Now more than ever we must be committed electing representatives to create laws that help, not harm. Dr. Victoria Wilburn and Andrea are running to serve Indiana for this reason - to be representatives who create laws in the name of freedom, not control.

Join us **Wednesday, October 5 at 8 pm (tomorrow!)** for a panel discussing the women's health crisis and how it fuels further health inequities in Indiana.

| | Peter, MLG showed us exactly who she is during the debate Friday night.
* Under her leadership, our prison population is down 20% while violent crime is up 30%.
* Thanks to her extreme shutdowns in 2020 and 2021, nearly 3⁄4 of our kids cannot read or do math to proficiency.
* Our state has achieved the ranking of having one of the highest unemployment rates in the nation.

Peter, MLG is not the governor we deserve. New Mexico is a beautiful place, and I want more New Mexicans to see our home as somewhere to **return to.** We’re working hard in these hours after the debate to make sure every last voter throughout our great state knows everything that MLG said - or didn’t say - in Friday’s debate. [**Your support can help our success with this. _“Show me your friends and I’ll show you your future.”_ You’ve heard this before, right? Well, Peter, MLG showed us **exactly** who she is and **exactly** who her friends are. Most of them are wealthy, Far Left zealots who want to do everything they can to make sure New Mexico remains under their out of touch control. With MLG remaining in power, **that’s the future New Mexico can expect.** I know we can do better - and, I’m **proud** to have **you** among my list of friends. My campaign reflects that. We’ve had **considerably more supporters** step up from right here in New Mexico than MLG has been able to move to action, and that’s not by accident or coincidence. **Our campaign is funded by and built upon the very people that MLG has ignored, Peter.** The family wondering how they’ll make ends meet after dad’s job hasn’t come back since MLG’s draconian lockdowns, bills have stacked up under the weight of Joe Biden and MLG’s inflation, and MLG’s Green New Deal home energy prices keep making things worse. The small business wondering how they’ll be able to stay open when everyone in their town that would make a great addition to their staff ends up leaving for a better, more safe and free state. People **just like you,** waiting for the day that our government puts **their family FIRST again.** **It doesn’t need to be this way, and after Friday's debate, I’m more clear-eyed and confident than ever before that after Election Day, we will reclaim our state to do things differently.**

Mark Ronchetti

body:

Peter,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. Now, they're using an anonymous source to further slander me.

_**They will do anything to hold onto power. It's disgusting, gutter politics.**_

**I'm not taking this anymore. I am planning to sue the Daily Beast for this defamatory lie.**

Now you know how important this Senate seat is.

I knew what I was getting into when I signed up to run in this race. After what the Left did to destroy Justice Brett Kavanaugh's life when the Supreme Court was on the line, I knew they'd come after me too because control of the Senate is on the line.

They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

_**[I'm going to fight and win this seat for the great people of Georgia, but I need you to stand with me.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61504020:J6wuhXVRN:m:1:3317145305:F70D2EFA4AB3D033543264E86B119FA7:r)**_

The Left needs this Georgia seat to maintain their power, but we're not going to let them have it. If they take this seat, we won't recognize this country tomorrow.

What they're doing to me - and other candidates - is not right.

## Why Donald Trump Did NOT Endorse Jackson Lahmeyer & What Is Next?
---
Today, I just released **episode 1** of my new show "[Unfiltered w/Jackson Lahmeyer](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8558.1.eebce2b72b4c852d5284596040146ba4)." On this show, I will bring on guests that are _the best of the best_ in the areas of **church** , **politics** , **business** , **sports** & **entertainment**. On this first episode though I take a moment to be **real** , **raw** and **authentic** about my race for the US Senate in Oklahoma, why **Donald Trump** did not endorse our MAGA campaign and **what does the future hold**? Be sure to subscribe to my [YouTube channel](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8559.1.9fc65b60b04efb3b8793c1cbb4959fdb) to be notified each week of the newest episode. You can watch Unfiltered Episode 1 here: [https://youtu.be/T9RkHsF71i8](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8560.1.e77990ff2a278ac087fb37693db3c9b7)
---
| | [ Unfiltered Ep.1 ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8561.1.01f5f2a6cf04c233d9e9e0518722ce91)
---
---
## My First Time...
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8562.1.0bd6e638887acab11d7188506f6011a0)
---
[Jacob's Ladder](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8563.1.0d3ad287ce1d08f2dde5641564f2e3ea)...
I have read the story time and time again but **I have never preached a sermon on it** until this last Sunday at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8564.1.bc4fbc5ae14d13fe241aa4fed066b569).
All I can say is WOW!
There is so much _richness_ in the story of [Jacob's Ladder](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8565.1.1202767b2288a9dfee4ac7985cc2d012), especially in regards to God's Divine Council (angels, demons & Satan).
I have provided a link that you can follow to watch the message and I know you will be blessed!
Watch Genesis Pt. 30 - [Jacob's Ladder](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8566.1.2edd36c15cadf62d048a0b7f4a89e5a3) here: https://youtu.be/dKjLCY3lw-0
Also, I have started a new series on Wednesday nights at [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8567.1.a764deda6cd4aa33192266e30081175d) over the **Book of Revelation**.
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8568.1.d9e76bb12e66362920110bbe158ae4e9)
---
We are taking our time through the **Book of Revelation** by going verse by verse.
Watch Pt. 1 here: [https://youtu.be/oPfmX_Aus-M?t=2](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8569.1.d4dc1d66ce71b43f94059c300ede9c66)
---
## HUGE News!
---
| [ ](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8570.1.d8d142a5682c8ea4b58a267c4bd56b28)
---
It's the _honor of my life_ to be the Pastor of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8571.1.0d626a9d9cdd2222d3312c0b86154b7d) in Tulsa, OK.
God has blessed our church with **tremendous growth**.
Last year, we launched a second Sunday service to make room for the growth.
Currently, we have services every Sunday at 9 & 11 am as well as Wednesday at 7pm.
**Our current location has been amazing, but we are outgrowing it.**
On Sundays at 11 am, I will find myself in the church lobby watching cars circle our parking lot trying to find a place to park because we have run out of parking before the service even begins and as a Pastor that's a horrible thing to see because your heart's desire is to reach people.
Last year, we began seeking the Lord for _direction_ on addressing this good problem.
God has poured out His favor on [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8572.1.48513b88d0d2680cb20020eb3936cf12)!
We have **acquired 6 acres in South Tulsa** between 81st and 91st off of Memorial.
I approached the owner of the 8 acres attached to the 6 acres we have acquired and asked what he would sell it to [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8573.1.7e85902112fd6eb3226e7fa4edb30e21) for and his response was reasonable. He said, "$750,000."
I then asked him if he would take $100,000 and he said, "**yes**."
**That's a MIRACLE!**
We are in a position to purchase 8 acres of prime real estate in South Tulsa for $100,000 that could be the potential home of [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8574.1.d9392648ec06d52df995f721d13f21df) in the future.
Currently, [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8575.1.c34d626826769a8cab5a9b2f2c8bb28b) is debt free, and I believe we should remain debt free.
**In order to remain out of debt, I need your help.**
We need to raise $100,000 over the next 60 days.
**So far, we have raised $25,000!**
I'm asking for you to come partner with what God is doing through [Sheridan.Church](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8576.1.5bfb9b96c334cc08032caa99e1a474be) and help expand the Kingdom of God.
A gift of $5 or $500 will be a HUGE help.
**If everyone that this email goes out to does something, we will have more than enough to acquire the 8 acres in cash.**
God is doing great things at [Sheridan](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8577.1.b5f22c8e8b2e1fdc754d730e33aaeed8), and I believe if you help bless God's house that in-return God will bless your house.
Please ask the Lord if this is a project that you should partner with us in.
You can partner with us by visiting [www.sheridan.church/give](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8578.1.840f451dc2a03296ebcd92216ac771f4) and know that I am beyond grateful for your help.
To see the land, watch this video announcement here: [https://youtu.be/GEth9C0quzU](https://sable.godaddy.com/c/375205?id=14650581.8579.1.e9a5f15985afb7df7f79e5cc3b043f2d)
Thank you,
Jackson Lahmeyer

JACKSON, Ga. - Today, Republican nominee for Lieutenant Governor of Georgia Burt Jones launched his first statewide tv and digital ad of the general election. Burt's new TV ad entitled "[Small Town](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001Oma0irirQo2uXmlUvcbk0mQuVBi6erfhk_cZ4NVXmQVQsZ3B62Zgp3i4rgG3xg1E24nJVbUinnK3kXdwUHM9eXe6DycuAXsOzInaWYIz8rovAFuerndzlxrPxFUJj62Zr_RYl333jybKGrsX3yuJfw==&c=FyOZekfjR_IMqm-cFqwyVDj7PiUB7EAmDZ2pzMNzF_NR3vgv6t_50Q==&ch=0COh9cc2P7DRR-1fg0qkbuBTmaOwfPaYuR7Lx_TsDIv_hWgaKL7fig==)" highlights his background as a sixth generation rural Georgian, his record of lowering costs and delivering results as a business owner and State Senator, and showcases his priorities as our state's next Lieutenant Governor. body:
Conservatives and people of faith will no longer have their
Constitutional rights upheld.

Peter:
Joe Biden sent the FBI in full SWAT gear to
raid the home of a Pro-Life activist the other day - further
proving that there is now a two-tiered system of justice in this
country.
This is the message the Left wants us to
hear: Conservatives and people of faith will no longer have their
Constitutional rights upheld.
In fact, the Biden Administration appears to
have no shame in using the FBI to target and intimidate its
political opponents. They don't care if it's a former President
or parents who voiced their opinions at school board meetings
because they wanted to prevent teachers from promoting CRT and
gender identity classes.
Biden and the left are willing to go as far
as to attack us for refusing to accept revisionist history and
have even called upon Big Tech and Big Corporations to punish us
if we disagree.
No freedom-loving American can sit on the
sidelines. We must join together and say, "NO MORE!"
I am demanding answers from the Biden
Administration and refusing to allow them to strip any American
of our Constitutional Rights. Join me in me fighting back against
Biden's tyranny with your $25, $50, or $100 donation today!
It's time to hold the Biden Administration
accountable, but we can't do it if you're sitting on the
sidelines this election. We'll end up losing more than just
Congress.
NO MORE schools that can be trusted to teach
our children properly.
NO MORE safe communities, because police
departments will be abolished.
NO MORE guns in your home, because the
government doesn't trust you.
NO MORE courts to uphold our Constitution.
NO MORE speaking freely.
NO MORE democracy.
You may think these warnings are hyperbole,
but look around you. Biden and the Left continually attack all
of us for standing by our faith and our values.
They've done nothing to hold Antifa, BLM, or
the people who vandalized pro-life pregnancy centers accountable.
But they will gladly send the FBI after anyone who questions
their Marxist agenda.
At what point will you say, "NO MORE" before
there is NO MORE to fight for?
Help me fight back before it's too late with
your $50, $100, or $500 donation today.
What happened to Pro-Life activist Mark Houck
is just a preview of what it will look like if you refuse to say,
"NO MORE."
Freedom-loving Americans and people of faith
are now targets. It's not just Republican members of Congress or
a former President who has to worry anymore.
That's what's at stake here, and it's why I
need your help to continue fighting back.
Are you ready to say NO MORE to Biden and his
Marxist takeover of our country? If so, then donate today.
For America's future,

Josh Hawley
U.S. Senator, Missouri

There’s no doubt in my mind that our nation’s citizens are in need of relief. But instead, President Biden has throttled U.S. energy production. And he has trapped much of our nation’s vast energy reserves behind a wall of bureaucratic red tape. That’s why I’m sending you this email today. I’d like to hear how the Biden administration’s energy policies have affected you and your family. With only one seat standing between us and a Republican majority in the Senate, we can’t take any election for granted.
#
Peter,
As you might know, my good friend and fellow Illinoisan Tammy Duckworth is up for re-election in **less than 5 weeks.** **[I’m asking for your help to re-elect Sen. Duckworth, but first, let me explain why:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51984244/370961393/1848808263?refcode=dd_em_221005_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2RlYzEzMS1iYTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XOuoP5ImjzuhRm3pIKCcWgfdlntuFl7jgxU2YM2gfa8=)**
Over the course of the pandemic, I’ve worked hand in hand with Tammy to deliver for working families and communities across Illinois.
She’s been a key ally in the fight to bolster child care programs, deliver federal funding to Illinois, strengthen our state’s infrastructure, support small businesses, and much more.
**But Mitch McConnell’s GOP has a different vision for Illinois and the United States and they’re promising to dismantle all of our progress if we give them the opportunity.**
With only one seat standing between us and a Republican majority in the Senate, **we can’t take any election for granted.**
**[Tammy is a partner I can’t afford to lose, Peter. Will you split $5 now to help us continue fighting for Illinois in Washington, D.C.?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51984245/370961394/1848808263?refcode=dd_em_221005_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2RlYzEzMS1iYTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XOuoP5ImjzuhRm3pIKCcWgfdlntuFl7jgxU2YM2gfa8=)**
She and I share a simple philosophy when it comes to public service: we champion the issues that make life easier and better for everyone.
And we know there’s more to do in 2022 and beyond. But with Senate Republicans promising to take us in the wrong direction by federally banning abortions, hiking taxes, and cutting funding to vital programs like Social Security and Medicare, we need to win this re-election.
**[So that’s why I’m asking: can I count on your support in the fight to re-elect Tammy by splitting a $5 contribution now?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51984246/370961395/1848808263?refcode=dd_em_221005_1&amount=5&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=Englewood&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODQ4OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyM2RlYzEzMS1iYTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=XOuoP5ImjzuhRm3pIKCcWgfdlntuFl7jgxU2YM2gfa8=)**
My best,
Dick Durbin

body:
I wish I was making this up.
But *even more* news came out about Dr. Oz today... and I think you’ll probably want to read it for yourself:
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20221005_CGVA_Fetterman [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20221005_CGVA_Fetterman]
That’s right. During his time at Columbia University, Dr. Oz killed *hundreds* of dogs + an entire litter of PUPPIES!!
You already know me + my team stand firmly on #TeamPuppy. Our pups, Levi + Artie, are basically spokesdogs for my campaign.
http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20221005_CGVA_Fetterman [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20221005_CGVA_Fetterman]
We can’t afford to send a literal puppy killer to the U.S. Senate. Will you split a donation of $25 or more between my campaign and CommonGood to help me send Dr. Oz back to New Jersey + keep him far, far away from any position of power? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/cgva_2021_jf?refcode=20221005_CGVA_Fetterman]

Every time we think Dr. Oz couldn’t get worse... he does.

Dr. Oz has killed HUNDREDS of dogs throughout his career, including an entire litter of puppies. Every day this guy proves he’s just the worst of the worst.

Eric Lynn for Congress [https://nvlupin.blob.core.windows.net/images/van/NGP/NGP24/1/93680/images/lynn-email-logo.png]
Hi team –

We wanted to be the first to share this exciting news. Planned Parenthood Action Fund just announced their endorsement of Eric Lynn for Florida's 13th Congressional District.

secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=675f6b7c-be44-ed11-b495-002248258d38&refcode=221005_hq_plannedparenthood_i1 [secure.actblue.com/donate/el-email?refcode2=675f6b7c-be44-ed11-b495-002248258d38&refcode=221005_hq_plannedparenthood_i1]

This endorsement is a huge win for our team. Eric has been at the forefront of the fight for reproductive rights his entire career. Just this year, he's marched in dozens of women's rights rallies, protesting and speaking out against the recent Supreme Court decision overturning Roe v. Wade .

Eric has committed to codifying abortion rights and the right to same-sex marriage, as well as expand access to affordable healthcare, especially for women and other vulnerable communities.

Planned Parenthood Action Fund is an organization that has tirelessly fought for those rights, and Eric is proud to have their endorsement of his campaign and political vision.

Eric's opponent, on the other hand, has allied herself with some of the most anti-abortion, right-wing politicians in the country. Think Marjorie Taylor Greene and Donald Trump. Luna has called herself a “pro-life extremist.” She wants to ban all abortions, with no exceptions for rape, incest, or to save the life of the mother.

The fact is, if Eric's extremist opponent, Anna Paulina Luna, wins in November, reproductive rights across the country could be irreversibly threatened for decades to come.

We need to protect our Democratic majority in Congress to codify the right to an abortion and expand reproductive rights for all Americans. | | \---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Aaron Jacobs Subject: Close Hold -- Update on the NH Senate Race

Hey all – I need to be clear with you about where things stand in our race.
---
**We are being outspent by national Republicans.**
---
* GOP groups are spending over $58 million on ads in New Hampshire.
* We’re being outspent, and the spending gap is widening. In the last three weeks of the election, Republicans are slated to spend $3.5 million more than Democrats.
* Don Bolduc just reported that "In the last week, he has already surpassed the amount raised during the entire year," while our fundraising has slowed down significantly. If this trend continues, GOP dominance on the airwaves will get even stronger.
* The NRSC is upping their spending in NH, and just booked an additional $1.1 million.

---

body:
Fellow Conservative:

The fight for the United States Senate this
November is going to come down to Wisconsin - and my close friend
and ally, Senator Ron Johnson.

If you have followed politics in the last few
years, you know that few, if any, in Congress have been more
passionate or effective leaders. No one has done more to expose
the Left's Covid lies. No one has fought harder to seal our
borders, protect our children, and preserve the integrity of our
elections.

Ron Johnson does what he says he will do. He
took an oath to support and defend the Constitution - and he
works hard to do that in the Senate every day.

Please help build a conservative Senate by
supporting Ron Johnson in Wisconsin today!

It doesn't matter where you live. Senate races
are national elections that affect the lives of all Americans.
The Left knows how important this race is, which is why everyone
on their side - from the media to Big Tech to the Democrats'
political machine - is pouring millions into Wisconsin to destroy
Ron Johnson.

But it's also why I'm traveling to Wisconsin to
campaign for him. And I'm not coming empty-handed. I'm working
with Senate Conservatives Fund to bundle contributions for his
campaign from freedom-loving Americans across the nation.

Please join me in this effort by making a
donation to Ron Johnson's Senate campaign.

SCF will pay all processing fees and transfer
100% of your donation directly to his campaign. You can also
support their other endorsed candidates at the same time and help
give Ron Johnson much-needed conservative reinforcements in the
Senate.

Conservatives cannot afford to lose this race,
so please take action now - before it's too late.

Conservatives can't win races like this with
blank checks from New York billionaires and San Francisco
millionaires. It takes bottom-up support from everyone:

▶︎ Every family ravaged by
Bidenflation;▶︎ Every town buckling under Biden's crime
wave;▶︎ Every parent labeled a terrorist;▶︎ Every voice
silenced by woke Big Tech censors; and▶︎ Every American who
still believes in the right to life, liberty, and the pursuit of
happiness.

I'm fighting liberals in Washington, and I'm
campaigning for conservative victory on November 8. But I can't
do it alone. We can only win this fight together.

Please join the fight. Join me in supporting
Wisconsin Senator Ron Johnson today!

Thank you for considering this urgent request
and for doing so much to help fight for America's future.

Sincerely,

JIM JORDAN
U.S. Congressman, R-Ohio

 

SUPPORT RON JOHNSON FOR SENATE

Few leaders in Congress have done more than Ron
Johnson in the last few years to fight for the truth and freedom.
Johnson was an early leader on the need for effective early Covid
treatments. The media and the Democrats laughed, but now many
have been forced to agree with him! He led Congress's most
vigorous investigation of Hunter Biden and the corruption
inherent in his "family business." And he has fought back against
the false media narratives about the January 6 riot and asks the
right questions about what the FBI knew, and when they knew it.
Ron Johnson is a courageous leader and we need him back in the
Senate next year!

Senate Conservatives Fund300 Independence Ave
SEWashington, DC 20003

Senate Conservatives Fund is a grassroots
organization that promotes conservative policies and helps elect
conservative candidates to the U.S. Senate. SCF was founded by
former Senator Jim DeMint to help the grassroots change
Washington.

Contributions to the Senate Conservatives Fund
are not deductible as charitable contributions. Contributions

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 5 GREATER GEORGIA LAUNCHES FINAL VOTER REGISTRATION PUSH
ATLANTA) Today, Greater Georgia announced its final voter registration push ahead of the Tuesday, October 11th voter registration deadline for Georgia's general election. Greater Georgia, which recently [announced](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=00190KQMnwLDLl7SSTZPGQbD2sycyonouO52XfCqucKfR1rh1MJfZ8_tWixWmvmR5Nk7tniTUgCcE18e2WEUIiCdmSrBUKGacVotzNEZiBjN4UG0NXwnjSGROhSQVFNViq0YjqdZ2aaAKh7y5khhL_HOVfUGe_sSvlnO-B-Y38XynxAB85iSld-3nRILC7e4SV-7rThz1bqpIxr-ghsu4Fcr6LqviGwqSQlcn8nY8vI9VcDlwbv0IxxAZBQRjyqdEdaHvZ1WvMjlNM=&c=PVr0xDhKtxluCO5q5k9Q24sKaOF4Y1iVMS0vg0dr-MFRczglfOvsWg==&ch=1L-iw6Lp_g-_A5TsJb_FOUw6gTxlLvw0UHH7tflkhLgeS2_bGw0fTg==) over 2.2 million voter contacts since its inception, will continue to engage with unregistered conservatives over the next week through handwritten postcards, text campaigns, neighborhood canvassing, and a final "Red Wave Registration Rally" in Cobb County this Saturday.
"Since the beginning, Greater Georgia has been dedicated to building a year-round voter contact machine to educate, register, and mobilize conservatives across our state," said Greater Georgia Chairwoman Kelly Loeffler. "Every single voter engagement and registration event over the last year and a half - whether with the Asian, Black and Hispanic communities, women, students, or consumers - has been building to this moment. With less than one week left until the October 11th voter registration deadline, we're confident that we will reach - and register - conservatives that will expand the electorate in November."
The deadline to register to vote in Georgia's November 8th General Election is next Tuesday, October 11, 2022.

Peter,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. Now, they're using an anonymous source to further slander me.

_**They will do anything to hold onto power. It's disgusting, gutter politics.**_

**I'm not taking this anymore. I am planning to sue the Daily Beast for this defamatory lie.**

Now you know how important this Senate seat is.

I knew what I was getting into when I signed up to run in this race. After what the Left did to destroy Justice Brett Kavanaugh's life when the Supreme Court was on the line, I knew they'd come after me too because control of the Senate is on the line.

They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

_**[I'm going to fight and win this seat for the great people of Georgia, but I need you to stand with me.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61511177:Jz07ZXVcN:m:1:3317145305:7D3B7535FB76C9537803B14F586DAC70:r)**_

The Left needs this Georgia seat to maintain their power, but we're not going to let them have it. If they take this seat, we won't recognize this country tomorrow.

What they're doing to me - and other candidates - is not right.

**[They are desperate to win these Senate seats because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61511177:Jz07ZXVcN:m:1:3317145305:7D3B7535FB76C9537803B14F586DAC70:r)**

We have tremendous problems in this country, and we need new leadership in Washington. The Left will try to buy seats, lie, and do whatever they can to get us off our game. But their attacks have made me ready to fight even harder now.

Dear Friend,
Today marks five weeks until the November 8th election. That means we have 34 days to build up our coalition of voters in Tennessee who are tired of Bill Lee’s absent leadership. We can’t take our foot off the gas now.

Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**

What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zhjes1hlea66g8u699f2kn3a5fa8cac7rjta98hg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjge6pr5clh2bs)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://e.americanbriefing.com/rd/9z2zd6qvsmha3758eetv2nkrva0tmeqdo970d9k59ro_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjge6pr5clh2bs)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Fellow American,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. Now, they're using an anonymous source to further slander me.

_**They will do anything to hold onto power. It's disgusting, gutter politics.**_

Now you know how important this Senate seat is.

I knew what I was getting into when I signed up to run in this race. After what the Left did to destroy Justice Brett Kavanaugh's life when the Supreme Court was on the line, I knew they'd come after me too because control of the Senate is on the line.

They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

The Left needs this Georgia seat to maintain their power, but we're not going to let them have it. If they take this seat, we won't recognize this country tomorrow.

**[They are desperate to win these Senate seats because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c45136%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Ik3l8PGn7zVAlOOB1dogTw&sysid=1)**

Dr. Bob's marketing team here. To keep all of Doc's supporters privy to our objectives and goals in the last month of the election, I thought we'd pop in for an update.
You may have seen that Dr. Bob's opponent, Jack Bergman, is starting to advertise again heavily. He plans to buy this election, and they just dumped over half a million dollars into a 30-day media blitz.
You won't be able to get away from their ads. There's some good news and bad news.
Good News
Team Bergman has been slowly eroding the public's trust for nearly six years, and Dr. Bob Lorinser has been building it his whole life. A half a million dollars doesn't erase half a decade of Bergman's atrocious voting record.
The other good news is their targeting isn't as nearly as sophisticated as ours, and they're wasting a lot of money.
Bad News
We can't compete with that dollar amount. We've been raising good money for a year, but Bergman has been raising funds for nearly seven years, and over 1/3 of their cash is from PACs, dark money, and giant corporations.
For the past 400 days, we've made critical investments into Doc's brand. We've hit every corner of the district. Bergman thinks he can just swoop in with his Louisiana checkbook and trick voters into overlooking his record.
We're not going to let that happen.
Right now, our ads are hyper-targeted. If you're already in Dr. Bob's corner, you likely won't see many if you're a supporter and he's earned your vote.
But, when we launch the ad, we'll send you a direct link through e-mail and you will be the first to know!
Can you contribute now so we can ensure our targeted voters aren't just seeing misinformation and propaganda from Jack Bergman?
There are just 34 days until the election. Many voters are already voting. Our production team is working around the clock on the latest ad, and this call to donors is urgent. We need you now.
Thank you,
Andrew
Marketing / PR
pr@votedrbob.com

I'm confident I can be an influential member of Congress for the First District and guide us on a national and worldwide stage under the ideals and principles of what it means to be a proud American. I genuinely care about every one of you, whether you are a democrat, republican, or independent. If elected, I will strive to be the voice for all district residents. My family, friends, and staff have put everything we have into turning our vision of this great state into a reality, and we will continue to work towards achieving that objective. Every day, we build and strengthen partnerships with voters and citizens alike who align with the vision we want to bring to the United States and Northern Michigan. I particularly love meeting and working with the younger generations. They are the voice of the future and are very active and enthusiastic in learning how to be involved.
The United States is divided economically, politically, and culturally more than ever before. So, it's time to unite, and it's time to come together and push for government solutions that reflect the best of Northern Michigan's values and priorities.

Our Apps or other services features may rely on this location information to provide certain location-based services, such as our promotional offers, merchandise offers, event information, or other Save America-related content that may be of interest to you. We may also use location information to improve the functionality of our Apps and our other applications and services. If you do not wish to have this location information collected and used by us, you may opt out by disabling the location and Bluetooth features on your device and/or in our Apps. As a general note, you may choose not to provide certain information, but you may not be able to access certain content or take advantage of certain features of the Services.
Depending on your device, we may use third-party services to provide mapping services. For example, we may use Google maps on specific devices. You can learn more about the information that Google collects through its mapping services at google.com/privacy.
D. User Submissions. You may have the ability to use the Services to communicate with other users of the Services and post comments to or otherwise interact with certain aspects of the Services that are available to the public and/or other users. We may collect any information you submit, post, or provide in such activities and reserve the right to store any information about the people you contact via the Services.

body:
Warnock for Georgia

| | | | | Peter, **_Herschel Walker's eldest son, Christian, has shared that he and his mom--Walker's ex-wife--moved constantly in the past because they feared his dad would find them and kill them._** **[Can you join us right now in giving $5, $10, $25 or whatever you can afford to ensure Senator Warnock holds his seat and we have a chance at the future we all want for ourselves and the coming generations?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T09728e58-d5fa-4f5e-b964-a34faead1108/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** _We already knew Walker held a loaded gun to his ex-wife's head and said "I am going to blow your f'ing brains out." That a second woman filed a police report, accusing Walker of "threatening to kill her." _ **Now The Daily Beast has reported that Walker--who after the Hobbs decision made clear he believed there should be NO EXCEPTIONS to an all about abortion ban, if a woman's life is in danger, too bad--took his girlfriend to get an abortion in 2009 and paid for it. Breathtaking hypocrisy.** **_At that point, Walker's overtly MAGA-supporting son had enough, and shared statements and videos that he and his mom had to move around to escape the risk of being killed by his dad. Again, Christian Walker is a MAGA Republican supporter, he has no motivation to make any of this u_p _(if anything, it'll hurt the social media channels he's built around Trumpism)._**

Friend – **my roots are planted deeply in Georgia soil.**

I grew up in public housing on the west side of Savannah – and I attended Morehouse College, a historically Black university in Atlanta. I went on what I called a "full faith" scholarship, meaning I didn't know how I would pay for my first full semester.
But through hard work and the support of my community, I was the first in my family to graduate from college – and then became the senior pastor at Ebenezer Baptist Church, the spiritual home of Martin Luther King Jr.

I know firsthand how attending an HBCU prepared me for a life of service – and I'm fighting tooth and nail in the Senate to make sure every kid has the opportunity to achieve their American dream.

body:
My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washin

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zsc2cnqnma381oh4tkhscf3kdnfdj9372qan5oe0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqikrirlttst3212o36g1i2h60udcedbofurbej0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvlhoc28vha7e6pm8d5kijdu604v3es9v0ie04po_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkke08nsm9qln8jpcqtqbdd6vktlrkfp8r7kmlkg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z52nrj8aujuqiekae6d3t3liggn1dbl285ovnsqg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgfsi6veqdukdfkv6fcuode8pdioeheirp1h93v8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zgf4kk7gr3cuplfm37d7c18o52p2j9sfk432uis0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z6skbcbjm9hnifpionv3ttbtnhu7nm10r2c4jps0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0kb00m6dc1cs3gbla17nu6oj1hkkc8e9vv4ml2g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znvju5sq36g9i0ed781mj004d7sdfoed9ppbotag_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znk2vrvhv0r4u8eh028sjvfvau66e4u1jda4q81g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj8asnh7pfdvc0nth4gak2ra6sbtgblir0e4he7g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zibcid6ke4svnhsa8s7oi52aet68s3fsg6tpsvmg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh2vcn98jgep8i9ieh4nk1khtfofub0fr9n1q2t0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc9bota458p7kbmg5t4thn2qbk4aep09r25fm70o_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "JOIN TEAM SMILEY")
---
| [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zc0rr2uelatf8cbk5ig7u213uffg2lc33f67b9lg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4shhngs14jr1lkn61nab4e15gcdj8lqv76b4rlo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z76i673ri2f9mf0tvakkll8aleioub36r5vt8vpo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36c9h2bs "Step up now!")**_

subject: Can you add your name to say you support universal background checks for gun sales? It’s a small and simple act, but it will send a powerful message about the size and strength of our movement.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
In less than two months, we are going to have a new Congress.
#

Friends -
In less than two months, we are going to have a new Congress.
We don’t know who will control the House or the Senate, but we know the numbers will be different than they are today.
So one of our goals this month is to get ready to demonstrate to the new Congress that people are still hungry for change that will make our communities safer from gun violence.
And when your senators and representatives ask what we’re hearing, we want to be able to tell them their constituents still prioritize passing universal background checks.
So today, we’re asking you to make your voice heard. What do you say?
[**Can you add your name to say you support universal background checks for gun sales? It’s a small and simple act, but it will send a powerful message about the size and strength of our movement.**](https://go.giffords.org/signup/giffords_em_ubcpetition_oct22/?source=em221005-1-30&refcode2=2562.3935704.iBazWo&akid=2562%2E3935704%2EiBazWo)

Universal background checks are one of the few issues in this country that has the support of Democrats, Independents and Republicans alike.

The team at Giffords

body:
I wanted to share these special moments with you.

| |
---
| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z2cqqt9gfakn9u5rthv9j44gufcpnen9uv23avpg_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zvbsuqaate8qu4ck80cvid37d8vm8c5gg0mtv6ag_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhv3g5kobcfr0h5e0ip82apmu1tjlqfrci2213qo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zl0fir6p55knulqc6pltb099diu88cf2h9heh4m0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zdms0ohstige2j0j6vpc9gj4dtnssthotv07h51g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z9brc62r45u1j37op13nl8k00ag4uldklen8r7h8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zjekop4ecqa8cdr773eeq564cr73ghe49qghrvko_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zc440nl6hvnqujklqo1r79f581ubbdevrf3hidno_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zu4taer1p0pkct9g9f4dbj145dkp7s05tjj2gbig_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhpqga0kpmp87n7p3pib9tn8i5s5qqfd315361v0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far.")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z1q4019omv74o5ugibkvlabush5q14us0fs2m2fo_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2z4j7352c1ktjaqnhsehrkvg4q2dpjn5str1pcmo8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---

---

---
| [](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zgs01m4tn3bqmt5adksd7v7ccm5glhkonkd8vr7o_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "All Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zhdbrltbjfi735n62a15ukctc6av9bgutt4ttb0o_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "Rush support now to be a part of history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zq4v5t9lks78u6l7q7ljm2egm09he34bhdcjhqk0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zqr556svj7hf16kdnm54vus6sagf9vgr3j9bock8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie8o36cph2bs "Step up now!")**_

body:
The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia – in
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1nne448stjf9ip99522f8igu1pku3o0rqqrn88o_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie4o72c3h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4oni65q36cr2m3gndc5k69hm5chi6dqeeojjcuq76dj5mlie6oth6grb6t37mjjjfduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9n6mqe0tr2cor61cr4cuobapbi4no)
|
---
Fellow American,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. Now, they're using an anonymous source to further slander me.

_**They will do anything to hold onto power. It's disgusting, gutter politics.**_

**I'm not taking this anymore. I am planning to sue the Daily Beast for this defamatory lie.**

Now you know how important this Senate seat is.

I knew what I was getting into when I signed up to run in this race. After what the Left did to destroy Justice Brett Kavanaugh's life when the Supreme Court was on the line, I knew they'd come after me too because control of the Senate is on the line.

They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

Stacey Abrams will fight for One Georgia — where we all thrive. And she

---
Friend,

That's me you're looking at.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51984692/370962231/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4569-fr-nd&recurring=0&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmRlYzEzMS1iYTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TP1aDnpVsbtY2PSkPTo8BC3svfvihNr3k7iAfmDEdWA=)I grew up poor in the segregated South, the daughter of a maid and a janitor. If you had told me back then, as a young Black girl, that I would become the first in my family to graduate college, the first woman to lead the Orlando Police Department, a congresswoman and a candidate for the U.S. Senate, well – I just don't know if I would have believed you. What I _did_ believe then – and what I carry deep in my soul to this day – is the lesson from my hardworking parents to "never tire of doing good."
It was my parents' words that inspired me to get into public service. It was their words that have driven me to do good every chance I get. From my time as a young social worker to my career as a law enforcement officer to my work representing my community in Congress – "never tire" is a mantra that I've held dear.
My unlikely story of opportunity is proof of what is possible and what should be possible for every American. **As Florida's next U.S. senator, I will _never tire_ in the work to make sure America is accessible and affordable for all Americans. **I will _never tire_ in continuing to do more good for you and your family.
But when it comes to this race, the GOP won't tire either: The Republican National Committee chair already attacked me personally, while Mitch McConnell and GOP outside groups are dumping MILLIONS into Florida to defeat me.

This is already shaping up to be the most expensive Senate election _ever –_ and with Florida's last Senate race being decided by a narrow 0.12% margin, every dollar we raise will count tremendously. **I know a thing or two about winning tough races, but I need your help because I can't do this alone.**
**[I'm depending on your grassroots support to power this historic campaign and help me fight back against the GOP's attacks – and right now, I'm falling short of my midnight goal. Can you make a $5 donation today to help make sure I have the resources to defeat Marco Rubio and protect and expand Democratic Senate control?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/51984693/370962232/2061369689?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk4569-fr-nd&recurring=0&amount=5&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Mzc4NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyYmRlYzEzMS1iYTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TP1aDnpVsbtY2PSkPTo8BC3svfvihNr3k7iAfmDEdWA=)**
Thank you so much for sharing this journey with me. It means the world to have you by my side.

Val Demings

[View this message in your browser](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z8qa0sjegtqubj6athoc0rmtmngk19j272epeq0g_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie6ob2c9h238h5e8he485he5o7csn7kuij791lmkp79dhk6eojacpl6er7actl6tr779hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onkslobatbh6qr62ddjm5ib8dhnc1gm3dthcar6dc32mlhb3c31e1r72cjnc8o7fduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6cc9n6mqe0tr6coqm1cr1cuobapbi4no)

Fellow American,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

Now, a liberal publication is claiming that I paid for a woman to have an abortion. **This is a flat-out lie - and I deny this in the strongest possible terms.**

This is another repugnant hatchet job from a Democrat activist, disguised as a reporter, who has obsessively attacked my family and tried to tear me down since this race started. He's harassed friends of mine, asking if I fathered their children. He's called my children 'secret' because I didn't want to use them as campaign props in a political campaign. Now, they're using an anonymous source to further slander me.

_**They will do anything to hold onto power. It's disgusting, gutter politics.**_

**I'm not taking this anymore. I am planning to sue the Daily Beast for this defamatory lie.**

Now you know how important this Senate seat is.

I knew what I was getting into when I signed up to run in this race. After what the Left did to destroy Justice Brett Kavanaugh's life when the Supreme Court was on the line, I knew they'd come after me too because control of the Senate is on the line.

They think they can threaten me. They think they can scare me. Right now, all they've done is energize me more.

_**[I'm going to fight and win this seat for the great people of Georgia, but I need you to stand with me.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zg09l8qsj298ocmisbs7gpl3huv3i281earhueb8_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie6ob2c9h2bs)**_

The Left needs this Georgia seat to maintain their power, but we're not going to let them have it. If they take this seat, we won't recognize this country tomorrow.

What they're doing to me - and other candidates - is not right.

**[They are desperate to win these Senate seats because they want to change this country, but we're not going to let it happen.](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zd7ithrnlfo49ncln9236rf72lte4egdc8fo0nv0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie6ob2c9h2bs)**

We have tremendous problems in this country, and we need new leadership in Washington. The Left will try to buy seats, lie, and do whatever they can to get us off our game. But their attacks have made me ready to fight even harder now.

Fellow American, control of the U.S. Senate is on the line, and the future of America is at risk. **[Will you stand with me in these final weeks of the campaign?](https://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z082uvh7pkficapcmpmsmhc1qergig8q2c5ipsj0_rp22sh2s8i66or1cjie6ob2c9h2bs)**

name: Marjorie Taylor Greene
subject: I am getting beat
body:
Peter -- My home has been swatted.
I've been the target of nasty attacks when I
am out with my family.

I have DAILY threats made against my life.
And despite it all, I have NEVER backed down
because the fight for America is too great and too important.
As you know, I am the Democrats top target to
take out. And I wear their smears like a badge of honor.
But the truth is, I need to know if I am
doing the right thing. I need to know if you still have my back.

Now more than ever, I could use your support.
LET MARJORIE KNOW YOU ARE IN THIS FIGHT WITH
HER
You see, my Democrat opponent is beating me
in fundraising.

He's also outspending me in a district where
career politicians stuffed 30,000 Democrats in my new district.
He is doing everything he can to defeat me.
And I fear I am falling behind.

Will you rush an emergency donation right now
to help me close the gap and win my election?

On top of running a race against one of the
most WELL FUNDED DEMOCRATS in the country, my campaign has been
saddled with HUNDREDS OF THOUSANDS of legal bills when Democrats
tried to remove my name off the ballot.

But that is exactly what the Left does:
target America First Republicans to try and bleed them dry so
they can SILENCE us.

I don't get the support from the GOP
Establishment, trial lawyers, or DC PACs and their lobbyists. . .

My support comes from Americans like you
chipping in $25, $15, or even just $5.

And 1,000 Patriots like you chipping in $5 is
more powerful than one corporate lobbyist writing a $5,000 check.

That's why I am writing to you right now.

I hope you will rush an immediate donation of
$15, $15, or even just $5 right now.

We are so close to Election Day. And I know
times are tough.

But the Democrats are breaking fundraising
records and the simple truth is we must keep up.

So please, if you can
afford to chip in a generous gift, I hope and pray you do.

Talk soon, MTG
MTG

Greene for Congress, Inc.
3 Central Plaza #142
Rome, GA 30161
