| _**Courage in Defense of Democracy**_
This week Congresswoman Liz Cheney sat down with Syracuse University's Vice Chancellor and Provost Gretchen Ritter for a conversation [entitled](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=fbb8250654&e=5c185e30ce) "Courage In Defense Of Democracy" at the Goldstein Auditorium on the school's campus. Video of the full conversation [can be seen here](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=e0326d3a9c&e=5c185e30ce) and please watch some of the individual highlights below:

[Cheney: We Have A Duty To Ensure This Isn't The Last Generation To Know A Peaceful Transfer Of Power ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=1106c6f6b7&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| [ ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=cd220d2b44&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| **CONGRESSWOMAN LIZ CHENEY** : _Thank you very much. It is wonderful to be here, wonderful to have the chance to be with my old friend Sean O'Keefe. And to be here to talk about citizenship. And to talk about citizenship here at the Maxwell School with the provost is particularly important and I'm honored to be able to do so.

I wanted to start today, before we go into questions, to talk about the topic of citizenship, and to talk about it, in particular, by taking everyone back to the night of January 6th. And on the night of January 6th, as the House was getting ready to reconvene, I had the opportunity, I wanted to see as we got back onto the House floor, I wanted to see what the condition was, what the circumstances were in Statuary Hall and in the Capitol Rotunda after the day of the attack. And so, I walked off the House floor, and I walked first into Statuary Hall. And Statuary Hall, as many of you probably know, was the first place that the House of Representatives met before the House Chamber was built. And on the floor of Statuary Hall, there are brass plaques that designate the locations of the desks of presidents who served in the House. And so, there's a plaque that designates where Abraham Lincoln's desk sat when he was a House member. There's another plaque for John Quincy Adams’ desk. And it's also the place where a number of statues representing different states line the walls. And on the night of January 6th, as I walked into Statuary Hall, leaning up against every statue were members of SWAT team, members of National Guard, members of the ATF, in riot gear, exhausted because they'd spent the day engaged in hand-to-hand combat with our fellow citizens. And because they'd spent the day defending the Capitol Building and defending our democratic process of counting electoral votes. And I walked around Statuary Hall and I thanked them for what they'd done, but there were not words to express the emotion of the fact that they'd had to engage in that battle. And then I walked from Statuary Hall into the Capitol Rotunda itself. And when you leave Statuary Hall, you walk underneath the oldest statue in the Capitol. And it's a statue of Clio, who is the muse of history. And in this statue, Clio rides in a chariot, the chariot of time, and she has a book in her hands, and she's writing in the book. And Clio is there to remind members of the House – she was put there when the House met in Statuary Hall – to remind us that what we do is recorded in the pages of history, and to remind us of our obligations and of our duties. And when you walk under Clio, you walk through a hall into the Rotunda itself. And this is a place where presidents lie in state. This is a place where the statues of Grant, of Washington, of Eisenhower, of Reagan, of our presidents line the halls.

And again, in the Rotunda on the night of the 6th, were armed men who had defended the nation, who defended the Capitol from that attack. And the message of citizenship is perhaps clearest in the Rotunda in many ways, but there are paintings along the walls of the Rotunda by [John] Trumbull. And one of them is a painting that depicts George Washington when he handed back command of the Continental Army, when he basically said he would relinquish command, when he began the tradition and the history in our nation of a peaceful transfer of power. And every single president of the United States, every one has honored that duty, has treated it as sacred, except for one. **And as we think about: what does it mean to be citizens in this Republic? What are the duties? What are the obligations, and what are the blessings? I think that it's important for all of us, not just those of us who are elected, but for all of us to understand the sacred nature of a peaceful transition of power, and what that means to the perpetuation of our Republic, what it means in this country, and what it means to young people. As I have thought about my own responsibilities and duties and those of all of us over the last year and a half in particular, I think often about my children, and I think about young people across this country. And if there is one thing, above all others, that we have to dedicate ourselves to, it's to the recognition that this Republic only survives if individuals step forward to defend her.** Those who make the biggest and most important sacrifice are the men and women in uniform who protect us. But all of us, every single one of us, has a duty to make sure that this isn't the last generation that knows a peaceful transfer of power in this great nation. And I'm absolutely committed to doing everything I can to make sure that that is the case. And I hope that all of you, especially the young people and the students who are here today, will leave today understanding and recognizing what a tremendous blessing it is that we get to live in a place where we get to make decisions about our government and our laws. But what a tremendous duty and responsibility of citizenship that that imposes on all of us. And it's a duty that we should all welcome and a duty that requires places like the Maxwell School who are teaching about citizenship and about the obligations of citizenship in this great country._

[Cheney: We Have To Come Together To Defend The Framework & Structure That Guarantees Our Freedom](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=451dc071eb&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| [ ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=003c05f5f8&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| **CONGRESSWOMAN CHENEY** : _You know, I have to say that the extent to which, and it's not just the members of the Committee, but it is Americans all across the country, the recognition that some things are above politics.**And we can disagree deeply about policy issues, but we never get to have the debate about tax policy or defense strategy or any of those other issues, if you let the constitutional framework unravel.** And so, we have to come together as Americans, regardless of party, to defend fundamentally the framework and the structure that guarantees our freedom._

[Cheney: We've Come To Accept A Level Of Venom In Our Politics That Is Very Dangerous](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=f9a5472935&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| [ ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=e0fe3cf762&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| **CONGRESSWOMAN CHENEY:** _I think that we saw on January 6th that words matter. We have to recognize that in the world in which we're living today, political violence increasingly is becoming part of our politics, and it cannot be that way. And we all have to be responsible for our words.**You know, when you see former President Trump just in the last 24 hours, suggesting in a pretty thinly veiled way, using words that could well cause violence against the Republican Leader of the Senate, saying he has a “death wish.” And then, you know, launching an absolutely despicable, racist attack against Secretary Chao, Leader McConnell's wife. And then you watch the fact that nobody in my party will say that's unacceptable**. And everybody ought to be asked whether or not that's acceptable, and everybody ought to be able to say, “No, that is not acceptable.” They ought to be required to say that. But I think that we've come to accept a level of venom in our politics that is very dangerous. _

[Cheney: We Need Every Good & Honorable Person Of Character To Step Forward & Serve The Country ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=a2d0e59253&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| [ ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=4f4f83cff0&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| **CONGRESSWOMAN CHENEY** : _I would just say that we take for granted sometimes in the United States what it means to live in freedom. But if you want to understand - Lincoln called America an inestimable jewel worth defending.**And if you think about what it means to be in a position where you can help to pass this freedom on to the next generation and you think about people who are fighting in Ukraine today for their freedom and you think about the sacrifices that so many people around the world and so many people in the United States have made for freedom, it is a noble thing to determine that you're going to serve your country and it's also required.**

We were talking earlier about one of the things that I hear sometimes, especially from my Republican colleagues, is ‘January 6th wasn't all that bad, and it wasn't all that bad because the institutions held.’ And whenever anybody says that, I tell them the institutions only held because there were individuals who took their responsibility to the Constitution seriously. Because there were people like Rusty Bowers. Because there are people like Shaye Moss and Ruby Freeman, election workers. Because there are people like Raffensperger who refused the pressure from Donald Trump. It only held because of people and while our government sometimes can seem huge, and it is, it’s too big. I'm a Republican. But while it can seem huge and while it can seem impossible to make a difference, the lesson of January 6th is that the only thing that makes a difference is people, and we need every single good and honorable person of character to step forward and serve the country. So I just can't encourage you more, as young people here today, watching, that we need you and that it is crucial for the survival of the Republic.

So I really hope you will continue your interest in public service and that you will decide that you're going to serve this country._

[Cheney: History Is Characterized By Moments Where People Put The Country First & Did What Was Right](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=d0ed31f6a8&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| [ ](https://cheneyforwyoming.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=18ec3f90845cedacf897e8c0a&id=8ee4570d89&e=5c185e30ce)
---
| **CONGRESSWOMAN CHENEY** :_But look, I do have real hope and optimism that the country will find people who will lead with integrity and with character and there are certainly people on both sides of the aisle today who represent that. I think it has to be said that the current leadership of the Republican Party in the Congress - in the House and a number in the Senate - are not leading that way. But I think that our history is characterized by moments where people put the country first and did what was right.

One of my sons is in a forensics class in which they have to memorize speeches and he happens to be memorizing Al Gore's concession speech in 2000. It obviously was a very hard fought campaign. Al Gore and I have a lot of disagreements on policy. I'm glad that campaign and election turned out the way it did, but go watch Al Gore's concession speech. It's worth the time, and as my son has been practicing it, it's very moving because Vice President Gore - I'm sure it was a very painful speech for him to give, but he captures how important it is. He says that the Supreme Court has ruled. He says, make no mistake, I disagree intensely, firmly with how the Supreme Court ruled, but in this nation it's our honored institutions of democracy that determine the outcome of our elections. **And I think that the vast majority of Americans on both sides of the aisle, believe in the honored institutions of our democracy and we’ll get through this period and we will elect people who are going to defend those.**_

subject: Episode #5, the Mules
body:
**EPISODE #5 MULES**
Who takes a picture of themselves dumping 10, 20, 30, 40 or even 50 ballots into a drop box? Are pictures of individuals dropping stacks of ballots into drop boxes required to get paid?

The recently released Dinesh D'Souza movie '2000 Mules' is based on ping data of cell phones obtained by True the Vote founder Catherine Engelbrecht and Gregg Phillips. The non-partisan election integrity group tracked hundreds of individuals making multiple stops at several different ballot drop boxes where they stuffed them with absentee ballots.

Detroit was one of the cities featured in 2000 Mules. True the Vote estimates that Detroit had at least 500 mules stuffing ballot boxes based on their cell tracking data. We now have video surveillance footage that shows multiple individuals dropping large stacks of ballots into drop boxes across Detroit.

Why are there no investigations into these serious claims?

Is this Jocelyn Benson's idea of "the most secure elections in history?"

Isn't it time for HONEST elections?

Isn't it time for an **HONEST Secretary of State**?

I'm asking for your vote on November 8th.

name: Cheri Beasley
subject: We cannot wake up on November 9 with any regrets.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Cheri Beasley for North Carolina
body:
#

When I kicked off this campaign, I promised this team and North Carolina that we would work harder than we ever have to turn our state blue.
I don’t want any of us to wake up on November 9 with regrets. We need to know we gave it our all, made the best decisions we possible with the information and resources at hand, and that we had nothing more we could have invested.
You may ask why I feel so strongly about this, and the truth is that my race for Chief Justice in 2020 was ultimately decided by 401 votes — out of over 5 million.
Yes, that’s just how close these races in North Carolina can be, but I sometimes wonder if there was more we could’ve done.
And now there’s a real chance that this Senate race comes down to a similar margin in November. Frankly, I can’t remember the last poll that didn’t show our campaign statistically tied.
So when the days feel long or the challenges feel steep, I think about those 401 votes. And I remind myself of the promise we made to work as hard as we possibly can. I will do everything I can today, right now, to make sure that we flip this seat.
I’m so grateful for everyone who has pitched in their time and talent already. But it’s going to take all of us, so I’m asking:

Hi friends,

Today is **World Teachers' Day** – a day dedicated to honoring our teachers who are making vital contributions to the education and development of our students. I couldn't let this day pass without taking the opportunity to **_thank all of the outstanding educators across the state._**

Teachers serve not only as instructional leaders but as role models and critical support systems for students during the most formative years of their lives and make sure our children receive the education they deserve. And in the wake of the pandemic, the impact our teachers have on our children, our communities, and our economy has never been more clear.

I am honored to have the support of the **National Education Association** and the **Wisconsin Education Association Council** as we take on Bryan Steil this November.

I have always been committed to strengthening our education system so every child has the opportunity to reach their full potential. When I get to Congress, I will be a voice for teachers – to continue fighting to make sure that our educators have the support and resources they need so they can focus on what matters most: **teaching**.

body:
You can still save the day but time is of the essence.
Peter, I'm devastated.
Just a few short months ago, Republicans were up by double digits and outraising the Democrats in key battleground races across the country.
_Nancy Pelosi looked like she was on the verge of losing her gavel forever. Far-Left progressives and socialists? Bound for the history books. Then everything changed..._
**The Democrats went into full-on panic mode. **They mobilized an army of Liberal megadonors, they bullied tech companies into running their fundraising ads, they rushed field teams into swing states, they launched smear campaigns against our Pro-Trump friends, they blanketed social media with attack ads, and they rallied the Liberal Media to run cover for them.
[**NOW -- FOR THE FIRST TIME THIS YEAR -- THE DEMOCRATS HAVE TAKEN THE LEAD IN THE NATIONAL POLLS, AND THE BATTLE FOR CONGRESS IS OFFICIALLY A COIN TOSS.**](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61516428:JiPGN_VN9:m:1:3317145305:67EA9C04456F5D4EB81D0484863CFC6C:r)
We're on the verge of LOSING the House and Senate.

body:
The folks in charge are slow to empathize but quick to cast judgements.
| | |
---
**Peter, watching my son Matt get sober was one of the hardest things I have ever witnessed.**
Addiction grips a person with a strength you simply cannot imagine if you've never experienced it firsthand. And while your family can support you, so much of the process of staying sober has to be done alone. Sobriety is never easy, and it's rarely a straight line. It's a matter of making it through enough of the hard days, minute by excruciating minute, until the good days outnumber the bad ones.
And Peter, I just don't think most lawmakers understand that.
The folks in charge are slow to empathize but quick to cast judgements. **They think that a few half-baked line items in a budget will fix things. And then they're free to go about their days, ignoring the opioid epidemic until election season rolls around again. **
But I understand. I know the complicated, difficult reality of addiction firsthand. I know exactly what happens to families when lawmakers refuse to truly address this issue. And it's a big part of why I am running for United States Senate.
Peter, we need Senate leaders who will make treatment accessible (especially in rural areas), listen to the experts, fund new research, hold Big Pharma accountable, strive for a better and more fair criminal justice system, and end the stigma and shame associated with addiction. That's exactly the type of legislation that I will fight tooth and nail for as Missouri’s next Senator.
**If you are on board with this fairer future, I need you with me.[Please, can I count on you to make a grassroots donation to my campaign? I promise you that I will do whatever it takes to end this opioid epidemic, but with just a few days left until the election, I cannot get to Washington alone.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52014664/371045128/-1746441832?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk335-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NzQ4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwZjUyZDc2Mi1lYTQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=E1oZ_VZYS-Y6F3tRNBXFKWieze8Ym6yDmatdMD9WPe0=)**

Right-wing conspiracist Jim Jordan's time in Congress is over.
Friends, Jim Jordan does not belong in Congress.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52014939/371045206/-744910851?refcode=221005_FR_whoiam-tw-RESEND_LOGO&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDI2ZDJmY2UtZWE0NC1lZDExLWI0OTUtMDAyMjQ4MjU4ZDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=C7FXJC-2QkIU_ayDpjXNObtImskt3eME1Vyt7fhCUO4=)

Friends,

**Look, folks, I’m not a politician.** I’m an entrepreneur and single mother who worked two jobs to myself through college. As a lifelong Ohioan, the granddaughter of a WWII vet, and the daughter of a small local business owner, _**I am in-touch with everyday Ohioans and Americans.**_

I know what it’s like struggling to make ends meet. I know what it's like when a loved one can’t afford healthcare. My mother has Stage 4 Breast Cancer and a heart condition that went undetected for year because my parents didn’t have healthcare.

**_I'm building a people-powered movement to unseat right-wing radical Jim Jordan in Ohio's 4th Congressional District because we're tired of working-class people being left behind. _**
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52014940/371045207/-744910851?refcode=221005_FR_whoiam-tw-RESEND_IMG1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS8xMDAwNjciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNDI2ZDJmY2UtZWE0NC1lZDExLWI0OTUtMDAyMjQ4MjU4ZDM4IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=C7FXJC-2QkIU_ayDpjXNObtImskt3eME1Vyt7fhCUO4=) Unlike my **_out-of-touch_** Washington elitist opponent **Jim Jordan** with his net worth of $21 million, I’ve lived through the personal experiences to understand what working-class Ohioans are going through. And I've got the business skills to finally deliver effective policies that will lift them up. Our district needs a leader who reflects everyday people and their experiences, not an extremist. https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221005_1 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/email20221005_1]
Elissa’s mom’s story motivated her to cap the amount seniors pay for prescriptions and finally allow Medicare to negotiate lower prices.
Her opponent, on the other hand, is backed by Big Pharma – the biggest pharmaceutical companies are among the largest contributors to the conservative super PACs that are attacking Elissa on TV.
And in the state legislature, Elissa’s opponent has a clear record of protecting the drug companies. Just the other month, he voted to continue allowing pharmaceutical companies to escape accountability when their drugs hurt or kill people, upholding a Michigan law that shields them from nearly all consumer liability (Michigan is the *only* state in the country with a liability shield for the drug companies). One of his top donors, the Koch-funded Americans for Prosperity PAC, opposes drug pricing reform and campaigned against it in 2021.
Meanwhile, Elissa got bills passed into law that take on Big Pharma and lower the price of prescription drugs by allowing Medicare to negotiate what it pays for prescriptions, capping monthly costs for insulin users at $35; and capping annual out-of-pocket drug costs for seniors at $2,000. Her Real-Time Benefits Act, signed into law by President Trump in 2020, allows consumers to comparison-shop for their prescriptions before they leave the doctor's office.
The contrast could not be more clear. Michigan does not need another politician who puts corporate interests ahead of what is right. clean_body: Peter, We just found out yesterday that Nike co-founder Phil Knight donated $2 million to Betsy Johnson in September, bringing his total donations to her campaign to a whopping $3.75 million. Johnson is polling below 20%, but she continues to raise massive amounts of money making her a potential spoiler in the governor’s race and helping Republican Christine Drazan, who has received large donations from the oil and gas industry. Recent polls show Drazan leading Tina Kotek, 32% to 31%. We can’t let an anti-climate extremist be our next governor. We’re going up against deep-pocketed opponents, but with the help of grassroots supporters like you, we can get Tina elected. Thanks for all you do. Sincerely, April Christenson OLCV Development Director | | | Peter, The election is less than six weeks away and I can’t overstate its importance for the future of our state. Both of the candidates running against OLCV-endorsed former House Speaker Tina Kotek have been named to LCV’s 2022 Dirty Dozen in the States, the worst candidates in the country for our environment. This is the first time ever that two candidates in the same race have both been on the list, which highlights how dangerous both Betsy Johnson and Christine Drazan are for Oregon’s environment. Right now, polls show Tina in a virtual tie with Christine Drazan, the Republican nominee for governor and former House Republican Leader. That means there’s a 50/50 chance of our next governor being an anti-environment extremist. We can’t let that happen. Christine Drazan is in lockstep with extremists and anti-environmentalists in her party. Independent candidate Betsy Johnson has a disastrous 20+ year anti-environment voting record. Both Drazan and Johnson have accepted significant money from the fossil fuel industry and have opposed every single major climate bill in Oregon’s recent history, including 100% Clean Energy for All, the Clean Energy Jobs bill, and the Oregon Environmental Protection Act. Drazan also helped lead the 2020 House Republican walkout to kill climate action. Both Betsy Johnson and Christine Drazan have pledged to end Governor Kate Brown’s executive order on climate if they are elected. We have no time to waste when it comes to addressing climate change and certainly no time to go backwards. We can’t risk electing either one of this dirty duo. This race is critical for the future of our state and our planet. We need all the support we can get to ensure that our next governor is a climate and environmental champion. Derek, Our 7th annual panel honoring the life and legacy of Barbara Johns is taking place on October 11th! That means that right now we can focus on two very, very important election-related actions. First, it is critical that you sign up to be a poll worker or watcher, if you are able to do so. Second, we need volunteers to do Get Out The Vote (GOTV) activities, most of which you can do right from your own home! Read on for details!

**URGENT: Election Workers Still Needed!** Some deadlines in certain states have already passed for poll worker positions, though the parties may still be able to get you in as a poll worker. In other states, the deadlines have not yet passed. This week, as soon as possible, figure out if you can apply to be a poll worker! name: Max Steiner
subject: Upcoming Events in Yuba City (10/7) and Shasta (10/11)
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Max Steiner for Congress 2485 Notre Dame Blvd, Ste 370 #194 Chico, CA 95928
body:
two upcoming events in our district. | |
---
Hi friend, The campaign season is heating up and ballots will be coming out soon. This is a great time to start talking to friends and neighbors about the importance of registering and voting. I don't want to beat a dead horse here, but the 2022 election is incredibly important. We have a mass of Republican lawmakers who were willing to lie about the 2020 election because Trump told them to. If they get reelected, it will make it clear to future politicians that lying has no consequences. That would be a disaster for future contested elections. But the point of this email is to highlight two upcoming events in our district. Sadly, LaMalfa has still not committed to a debate, although he "may" be able to make a Zoom Forum hosted by the League of Women Voters of Butte County, tentatively scheduled for October 20th. **First, we are having a Congress/Assembly Candidate Forum in Yuba City this Friday, 10/7 at 6:00 pm in Boyd Hall (970 Klamath Drive).** It will be moderated by Robert Summa, Editor of the Yuba City Appeal-Democrat. LaMalfa has been invited, but - unsurprisingly - has not confirmed. (I'm not hopeful.) **Next week on 10/11 5:00pm,****there is another Candidate Forum in Anderson (just south of Redding) for Congress and County Supervisors.** I will be joined by moderate Shasta County Supervisor candidates Baron Browning and Erin Resner at the Frontier Senior Center (2081 Frontier Trail). It will be moderated by Mike Warren, the former City Manager of Redding. If you're ever curious about upcoming events, the website has a page for them as well: https://maxsteinerforcongress.com/events Thanks for all of your support so far! Let's keep fighting for democracy here in CD-1! Max

This month, we acknowledge domestic violence survivors and uplift their voices to raise awareness. | | | [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953wB7DWu1u8h5QTGLUn-vuE3hu6E28TwOViBeqTZzuoBidy_4VnuIRLmOt7WxayZLUu8wrNI9o6Wnt6y4BUS0FnJ-5xLTdKgIQFyIDqpgDwb6Wm2NmsMUyk-ejSPUIV90lX-ejNBg1Xdexn9LuAc8Llimc78_V5U9klHJ0YqZkOud-0tppd8E1iE6Z47UHcjkuLaz2RLY1oQ4TkW_6aFH8cMwRTIrfTAaBfJyuaDjw1NDxeZ6zqvAp2UCZjkXj39SUqw4ttVef485MjAm_sMdan_5euJ5kXwTOSQstiiD9ygMBZftKa9aybv6e4xTBX_OqL-iJ_OjRe5Ll7z_mW9CW_eem16CsWmqVZLC3bh8pL374eCWSp_YHBo5P51SyXNvT9-kXiLPrKXjzJcKiF6pWvEG7HaXQDPZUsiPUXnrFx9yiSvpny7zWI1zkFfGO_AsCI/3q1/hYHz69KLQhCJqrYdYJYkiA/h0/qkhyjiEobM7mQkZe4DlAu3Ty4Budl8bIWLWAXydHSpE) | | Team,

October is Domestic Violence Awareness Month. I would like to acknowledge domestic violence survivors and uplift their voices to raise awareness for domestic violence issues too many face every day.

Today, 1 in 3 women have been physically assaulted, raped, or stalked by an intimate partner, yet only 37% of victims go to a hospital for treatment. Even worse, 137 women across the world are killed by a partner or family member every day.

As a major pillar of this campaign, I’m working every day to empower the women of Houston on my way to the mayor’s office. I founded Women for Amanda to create a space for women to come together and empower each other to create change in our community. But the work of empowering women doesn’t stop at political change. It must continue into every facet of women’s lives.

We must continue amplifying domestic violence survivors’ voices and dismantle every systemic barrier to justice. Together, we will create a community that hears and sees all in need.

Onward,

Amanda K. Edwards

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

| |

| | | Friend,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I’m running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFP4pPxoNHFSDxzQtVPTrf3_1V1pfPXHmMjhqk_-CpnqNAVp_cu1u25xTrf37fFK94vPnECXez4Gq6QSYbybRwwybHX01o73viWhkgjQxL8CXb7euM7Pdr9IpiZBEgHzfKl6PqQ2zu_y3nJX5do-1in5 "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFN42u0gDYzvOUyYBMftxH20sxhpuofULn7cfsQNvCUYN5mUMXUIPRMXxjkNvp9kkFeiQY8geWwposYDqHm8UyvQng3TNiYHykdCsG2qi5B1Wj51YqbVSI0qpSEk5lQ0_UBlgads0sUZCscytGCy8qs_ "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFM5Cb1DlKLUax_YMeJhxereWwVU-xgAPosXGeIO3D4xsWLjuhAmmUYwfEDulijJdYq8NJBT86tnOU7vEGO5b_Ktxh2XDEyOjTRv66Rxtdw1VxyCEigmjsTQiDSq5OQfJ61f5w56iI3fR6rMHVmj3y61 "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty’s side.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFPl0OPXp5TCvkQddiZQ-6wrPg9iYELOvxHsVbowcyZaguKgUsrTzzT7VlZAl4WYIounfToT1UkVXQlbxW3bwu8ekwnjK-m9M0fk0ysjQbxokOzFz6oEevQBAFvoMRIQ77MIfp5hEN3j6gUUcHQrGkva "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")

_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFPigGX038Yqd9Ldh5GyR1zT72TmvPPaBYTu28wieSThZ8A8JXTPp0Tjh6-9EZyY2eEsYgtnrYlwjf87j0-wSvXqOYbWfgH53OCOQhx--xFnbkasg-0eVEpcXg4hLGMdBwoXdPJGPPhxRk_P-MkV4ABm "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It’s not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way— _and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFMNLXGAddORaH32GPGkCz4rvuNEbF2Lv7eYvrCAGRn8e3rkcqOXAfMA0JJZ8iTo3jHzcAr9E2eI2ONXoWNet7_zQEP1cVanYUleCGwQRu10IUqEKpNbZbD7H6pVpAbFrBqUSNvHfLH7sZoKsNqCrqaf "I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to ‘see’ our children’s faces, he’s always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](http://links.reclamingamericanfreedom.com/u/click?_t=5ec072595b1347f09b4bac0de82ea87d&_m=f6c93e4cc39b4056b72ac0d628d10057&_e=L1bz1AtkRWA0yVrdcb8hbsHGUEjYi9LdPCnVe6T8v2dqR_geeXKRGpbRS4rqcei50Ap8TYvnN6niyknoDUFlVKVhF3M24EfSGjhuHWgMq8pjNVngIRzwED863gMd1nrzSTFHQNbPco8NOeBAymjmsVadjEK41R70zV6FR6SAzVYLOdGb7qA5Wr2YP9amBDsPzhu6YLLxzLLqVQ9HfFtMUwlJeza8zmNZgq8XL2oXbee01cKchJhSWvFPz-LYqzCACZW_w1p-HwWYbXq2iK2iRMxCI7UuDa-i46H3zGYvKFO1J5Fb1KMZ2p0H3Lz2Y6OLzAxL4ONpB5eY2n5QM50JFhAJRscHdfO-5TqcsNgs49FNi2gKdzOGzlDmegpOaAzK0ppZ6aBH5u_FrseCqlvS9V5scqLEgtSN7MDnZvVufO3HWnEYvKRbG7Hvqi-PB7ae "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I’ve shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

name: Nancy Pelosi
subject: Celebrating Hispanic Heritage Month — Speaker Pelosi’s Grassroots Volunteer Update with Rep. Raul Ruiz, MD, on Thursday, Oct. 6th at 4 PM PT / 7 PM ET
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Nancy Pelosi for Congress
body:
Dear Friends,

Less than 5 weeks from securing our great Democratic victory on November 8th and with early voting happening across America over the next few weeks, YOU have a key role to play in getting out a record vote to hold our Democratic House. For up-to-the-minute updates, please be sure to follow me at https://twitter.com/TeamPelosi.

As we continue our celebration of Hispanic Heritage Month, I am thrilled that we will be joined on Thursday at 4PM PT / 7PM ET for this week’s Grassroots Volunteer Update by my great colleague and fellow Californian, the Chair of the Congressional Hispanic Caucus – Rep. Raul Ruiz, MD. Chair Ruiz will discuss how Latino voters were instrumental in Democrats’ successes in 2018 and 2020 — and the work Democrats are doing to deliver for Hispanic and Latino communities.

Join our conversation. RSVP:

https://us02web.zoom.us/webinar/register/1016437740912/WN_zPE4Q9X5QGCZ53MwEQ6WdQ

In the Congress, Dr. Ruiz represents California’s 36th District – the home of Coachella. He is the proud son of farm workers whose community helped pay for his education, lifting him to three Harvard degrees. Dr. Ruiz serves on the Energy & Commerce and Veterans' Affairs committees. An unmatched hero for public health, Dr. Ruiz was an indispensable intellectual resource in our success in crafting and enacting the PACT Act, giving cancer care to veterans exposed to toxic burn pits and Agent Orange, and for our military families exposed to contaminated water at Camp Lejeune in North Carolina. A man of his word who promised he would always give back to the community that believed in him, Dr. Ruiz continues to pay it forward by changing lives from Mexico to Serbia to Haiti and, to this day, in the Emergency Room as he takes a shift when he is back home.

Under Chair Ruiz’s leadership, the Congressional Hispanic Caucus has prioritized equitable distribution of covid relief, infrastructure investments, and the inflation reduction law; secured jobs and environmental justice protections for frontline communities; supported investments in education, including Hispanic Serving Institutions and bigger Pell Grants; and lowered costs and increased access to health care.

As always, thank you for all you do as our VIPs – our volunteers in politics — who put us in power to deliver For The People.
NANCY

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

Derek, there are 34 days to go until this November’s election. **34 days.** We have to make every one of these days count because this election will determine the future of our country. This year, the stakes could not be higher. Now, I know we say that every election cycle, but what is at stake this year in these midterms is so apparent -- everything from voting rights to abortion is on the ballot. **If we defend the seats we need to hold on to our majority in the House and we protect --_or better yet, expand_ \-- our majority in the Senate, we can continue our progress. If we defend the seats we need to hold on to our majority in the House and we protect --or better yet, expand \-- our majority in the Senate, we can continue our progress. You haven’t made a donation yet this year. Can I count on you to make your first gift of the year? We passed the Inflation Reduction Act to lower energy costs, health care costs, and prescription drug costs. Democrats have proven that when the people put our party in charge, we know how to deliver results. From now until November 8, it is up to all of us to build on our momentum, including you. **McMaster has spent decades in politics — and what has it gotten us?**

**With McMaster’s record, we need to fire him. The Left will do anything to hold onto power. It’s disgusting, gutter politics. |
---
Peter,

**The Left is so desperate to hold their majority in the Senate, they're willing to do anything to win this seat in Georgia - including lie.**

They want to make this race about anything except what the true problems are in this country: inflation, a wide-open border, and crime. They don't want to talk about the real issues, so they make up lies about me.

body:
We need everyone to chip in
| Team,

Time is of the essence, so we'll keep this quick - _we 're in the midst of a pivotal moment in Arizona_ after a judge just reinstated a pre-statehood abortion ban.

**This is a TOTAL ban with required jail time for doctors, pharmacists, and other medical providers.** There are no exceptions for rape or incest. Don't just take our word for it - _champions of this ruling are calling it a total abortion ban._ [**Look, we can 't afford to waste any time. Right now, voters are being notified their mail-in ballots are on the way and more than 85% of Arizonans vote by mail. We need you to split a donation between Katie Hobbs, Kris Mayes, the Arizona Democratic party, the ADLCC, Adrian Fontes, and Voter Protection Project right now so we can turn Arizona completely blue and restore our rights.**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28572?t=6&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Katie Hobbs, Kris Mayes, Adrian Fontes, AZ Dems, ADLCC, and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28573?t=7&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $25 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28574?t=8&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)

[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28572?t=11&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
We can't let this stand. Fighting back will require winning elections on several fronts and **we 're only going to get there if _everyone chips in right now._**

Here's how we get Arizona out of the 1800s and in the 2000s:

**\- We elect Katie Hobbs as Arizona 's next governor.** Katie Hobbs will do whatever it takes to repeal the draconian 1901 law and restore our reproductive freedoms. She will never be afraid to use her veto pen to block _any legislation_ that compromises the right to safe, legal abortion care and will work tirelessly to stop these unprecedented attacks and secure women's rights for the next generation of Arizonans.

**\- We elect Kris Mayes as the next attorney general of Arizona.** Kris Mays believes Arizona's Constitution privacy clause overrides this abortion ban. She's pledged to use the AZ Constitution in court to argue against it and will overturn the current Attorney General's opinion of this total ban when she takes office. She will also use the AG's office to stop local prosecutors from locking up medical providers for abortion care.

**\- We flip the AZ legislature blue. Democrats are only two seats away in both the House and the Senate.** A Democratic-legislature can repeal this pre-statehoood total ban, other harmful laws, and re-affirm Arizonans' right to privacy.

**\- We elect Adrian Fontes as Secretary of State.** He will broaden Arizona's address confidentiality program to protect those seeking care or providing it from public harassment or arrest.
[**Like we said, this is an all-hands-on-deck moment. We must try to accomplish all of these goals to ensure Arizonans aren 't stuck in the 1800s. Will you chip in and split a donation between Katie Hobbs, Krist Mayes, the Arizona Democratic Party, the ADLCC, Adrian Fontes and Voter Protection Project right now?**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28572?t=12&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Katie Hobbs, Kris Mayes, Adrian Fontes, AZ Dems, ADLCC, and VPP will go through immediately:
[CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28573?t=13&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
---
[CONTRIBUTE $27 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28577?t=14&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
[CONTRIBUTE $50 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28575?t=15&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
[CONTRIBUTE $100 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28576?t=16&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
[Or a custom donation »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28572?t=17&akid=4817%2E878179%2EA0QmBR)
Every dollar for these campaigns and organizations will make a difference. **Arizona is only the beginning.** If we don't fight to get Arizona out of the 1800s, Republicans in other states will take note and turn around to pass these bans in their states too.

Thank you for your support in helping flip AZ blue so we can restore Arizonans' rights.

\- Katie Hobbs, Kris Mayes, Adrian Fontes, AZ Dems, and the ADLCC.

name: Candace Owens
subject: Proof that Hollywood is Satanic
body:
[](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518173:6b5lp_VrN:m:1:3253819041:F0DDBF6B1F6350FC2EEB5A0B4F7FA8E1:r)
Peter,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that's exactly what happened -- Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here's where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she's still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you're willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I've set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don't have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $25, $35, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518173:6b5lp_VrN:m:1:3253819041:F0DDBF6B1F6350FC2EEB5A0B4F7FA8E1:r)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program - Liberation Camp - for 80 children.

_BLEXIT 's Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago's most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America's minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $25, $35, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518173:6b5lp_VrN:m:1:3253819041:F0DDBF6B1F6350FC2EEB5A0B4F7FA8E1:r)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here's the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can't do it alone, Peter. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?

Yesterday, Erik was on "America Reports" with John Roberts and Sandra Smith. Erik discussed why border security is such a critical issue in Colorado:
"Crime is out of control, we are number one in the nation for auto theft, number one in the nation for bank robberies, we have become the cocaine capitol of the country. A lot of this is influenced by the disaster on the southern border...These open border policies are unaccountable, and they are harming everyday Coloradans."

# Quote of The Week
---
| |
---
| "We have to dispel the notion that legislation is the answer to our problems" --Erik Aadland on reducing the size of Federal Government
---
|

|
# Campaign Update
---
| |
---
| Canvassing, canvassing, canvassing!! The Aadland Army has been out in force this last week as usual. Area Coordinators (AC) are keeping their teams burning the shoe leather taking Erik's news to their neighbors
---
| |
---|---
|
Last night, Erik attended the Arvada Chamber of Commerce's "Advocacy After Hours". This event, hosted at Freedom Street Social in Arvada, featured candidates from races across the spectrum; Congress, Sheriff, State Senate and County Commissioner to name a few.

Members of the Aadland Army joined Erik to visit with folks, share literature and hand out Yard Signs.

Over the last week, ACs rallied their troops to once again walk the sidewalks, knock on doors and talk with our neighbors.
| | |
---|---
|
ACs Dennis and Kathy hosted a team of 25 for coffee and donuts before joining Erik on the trail in Chaffee County.

In Broomfield, Dave & Robin did stand-in duty for Thea in organizing her troops to talk with area residents.

Marlene & Jackie focused on Arvada neighborhoods while Laura continued to lead Evergreen volunteers through the high-country, as she does most days.
| | |
---|---
|
Last Tuesday, Park County AC David gathered his troops and walked through Bailey with Erik by their side. It's always fun to see the smile on our neighbors' faces when they open the door and see Erik on their veranda.

In all, the Aadland Army volunteers visited 1,600 homes. Top honors for effort go to Tim, Marlene and Cindy who called on over 350 folks themselves.

In between canvassing, Erik attended a couple of Candidate Forums. On Wednesday, The League of Women Voters hosted Erik and two other candidates for Colorado's 7th Congressional District. The event was presented online and you can watch the recording [here](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011_KGCAkeZtLrVjQT9td8m0Iy5-r6p33G1-xhQQWRBiXFoaFoUZhZ9xdnymqTg1QAnJYsePgImWsLBcNPfrdaaKpWIegV7WC6IS0_l8auCFwPQSJG2c2msg7iRv-nrNJSN7SWNypVV3J4pG55oH2QK4X9GG6RIsQkdvNgCR7uPBKUrDZkNuPFOA==&c=lEjwnywQ94fP7vWoB0LSw0x7O2OWLsCf85p1lt9CHr11GSUTzNU18w==&ch=ii2eStD1pI_60vvQ6Hh_3Xa2lezJQNoWc8P1gFqRojRREiWUWc8dng==).

On Friday, Erik was hosted by the Centennial Institute in Lakewood for a CD7 forum. The event was well attended by neighbors, students and others to hear the candidates and ask them questions. Although invited, Erik's opponent chose not to appear in person. She felt it adequate to address the constituents of this Congressional District with a 30-second television ad.
| |

## About Aadland For Congress
---
| |
---
| Erik's effort to represent Colorado District 7 (CD7) is a true grass-roots campaign. There is no family fortune behind this drive; no Fat-Cat donors from California and New York backing our organization.
Volunteers and professionals began joining the cause to help send Erik to Washington in March of 2021. Staff personnel now cross the spectrum of political pundits, professionals, friends and neighbors.
You can stand with Erik by contributing to our cause. We can't do it alone, but together we can do anything.

## About Erik
---
| |
---
| Jefferson County resident Erik Aadland is a West Point graduate and a twice-decorated Bronze Star veteran--one for valor--from his time in Iraq and Afghanistan. Concluding his army career in 2011 as a Captain, he pursued a career in the oil and natural gas industry with his work culminating as a project manager directing the onshore construction of the Leviathan Project in Dor, Israel. This project resulted in Israel being a net exporter of natural gas and becoming energy independent. Erik holds a master's degree in the field of psychology. We need to hold the banks accountable for abuse and enact stronger consumer protections | | | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52041450/371067011/-1964596891?ms=em-header&refcode=EMZ9B_COM_E_20221005_V1S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDgvMS84NzkzMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0NzVhMzU2Mi1mZjQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=u_Tk0PxZn0h669zR0_KipViQvRSVQrEnXQH9mPJ-1oQ=&emci=3b5a3562-ff44-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=475a3562-ff44-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=9027908)

I wanted to just give you an update on something I’m working on in the Senate. My office has been tracking a rising problem: fraud and scams on Zelle, the nation’s most popular peer-to-peer payment platform. The big banks that own it say it’s fast, easy, and safe. Well, that’s only two-thirds true. When everything’s working right, people can use it to quickly and easily pay a friend back for dinner, or send rent money to a roommate, or manage their small business. But more and more, bad actors have been defrauding people by impersonating reputable institutions, disguising their contact information, or even gaining access to someone’s account to make unauthorized payments. We started an investigation earlier this year and pressed for answers from the seven big banks that own and profit from Zelle. Only one bank sent back information on how many fraudulent transactions consumers had reported. The rest of them stonewalled. So it was time to make some noise. At a Banking Committee hearing last month, I asked the CEOs of the other six banks — including JP Morgan Chase’s Jamie Dimon — for the rest of the data. They didn’t have it. Jamie Dimon actually promised he’d send it by the end of the day — after the hearing would be over, the cameras would be off, and he wouldn’t have to answer any questions about it (oh how convenient). Despite that promise, I’m still waiting on numbers from him, by the way, and from a few of the other banks (not holding my breath). But others finally did send in their data. And this week, my office released the findings of our investigation:
* **Fraud and theft are on the rise.** Four banks that sent in numbers received $90 million worth of fraud and scam claims in 2020. For 2022, that’s on pace to be $255 million.
* **Banks aren’t providing refunds in the vast majority of cases where customers were fraudulently induced into making payments.** The three banks that sent in full data only reported repaying customers for 9.6% of scam claims, and only paid back 11% of what had been taken.
* And in even more extreme cases — when bad actors got into someone’s Zelle account and made unauthorized payments — banks only reported paying back 47%. That’s a **potential violation of federal law** and CFPB rules right there.

I’ll keep pressing for all the data so we can get the full picture. **But it’s clear: we need to hold the banks accountable for abuse and enact stronger consumer protections, including strengthening regulations that apply to platforms like Zelle. That’s exactly what I’m going to keep fighting for.** I’ll stay on this — and I’m grateful that you’re on this team. I work for the American people, not the big banks, and grassroots support keeps me in the fight. Despite that promise, I’m still waiting on numbers from him, by the way, and from a few of the other banks (not holding my breath). But others finally did send in their data. And this week, my office released the findings of our investigation: Fraud and theft are on the rise. Four banks that sent in numbers received $90 million worth of fraud and scam claims in 2020. For 2022, that’s on pace to be $255 million. Banks aren’t providing refunds in the vast majority of cases where customers were fraudulently induced into making payments. The three banks that sent in full data only reported repaying customers for 9.6% of scam claims, and only paid back 11% of what had been taken. And in even more extreme cases — when bad actors got into someone’s Zelle account and made unauthorized payments — banks only reported paying back 47%. That’s a potential violation of federal law and CFPB rules right there. I’ll keep pressing for all the data so we can get the full picture. But it’s clear: we need to hold the banks accountable for abuse and enact stronger consumer protections, including strengthening regulations that apply to platforms like Zelle. That’s exactly what I’m going to keep fighting for.** I’ll stay on this — and I’m grateful that you’re on this team. I work for the American people, not the big banks, and grassroots support keeps me in the fight. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth | = | | | | | | ---|---|---|--- | Paid for by Warren Democrats All content © 2022 Warren Democrats, All Rights Reserved PO Box 171375, Boston, MA 02117

**MEET MIKE:** | A CHAMPION FOR PRINCIPLED LEADERSHIP

Mike learned his love for the Constitution around the family dinner table. Mike’s father, Rex Lee, served as Solicitor General under President Ronald Reagan and later as President of Brigham Young University. As a child, Mike attended his father’s arguments before the U.S. Supreme Court, giving him a unique understanding of the government from an early age. As an attorney he developed a more complete understanding of why the Constitution is essential to the protection of life, liberty, and property.

After graduating from law school in 1997, he served as a law clerk to Judge Dee Benson of the U.S. District Court for the District of Utah. He then clerked for Judge Samuel A. Alito, Jr., who was serving at that time on the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit Court in Newark, New Jersey. After his second clerkship, he joined the Washington, D.C. office of Sidley & Austin, where he specialized in appellate and Supreme Court litigation. Several years later, Mike was invited to serve as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in Salt Lake City, preparing briefs and arguing cases before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Tenth Circuit. He served as Governor Huntsman’s General Counsel and then went to Washington for a one-year clerkship with Justice Alito at the U.S. Supreme Court.

Following his clerkship, Mike joined the Salt Lake office of the Washington, D.C.-based law firm of Howrey LLP. Mike has earned a reputation as an outstanding lawyer based on his sound judgment, writing and courtroom advocacy skills, and thorough understanding of the Constitution. Mike and Sharon have three children and live in Provo, Utah.

But some news came out about Dr. Oz... and I think you’ll probably want to

That’s right. During his time at Columbia University, Dr. Oz killed
*hundreds* of dogs + an entire litter of PUPPIES!!

You already know me + my team stand firmly on #TeamPuppy. Our pups, Levi +
Artie are basically spokesdogs for my campaign.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=oct2022_abs_em_fetterman.wMzrmx&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_TAN_GEN_AC_20221005_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1005&akid=1031%2E5257348%2EBefN-j ][IMG]

| | Friends,
My family knows firsthand what it is like to lose someone unjustly. My cousin, Emmett Till, was murdered at the age of 14. After allegedly whistling at a white woman (she later admitted this was a completely fabricated story), her family acted upon her lie and kidnapped Emmett from his uncle’s house in the middle of the night. He was brutally beaten, shot, and lynched. Too many families have a similar story to mine. That’s why we need representatives who are ready to stand up to injustice and fight to prevent tragedies from happening in the first place through education and advocacy.
One of the many reasons I decided to run for Congress to represent District 5 is that in 2022, 67 years after Emmett's death we finally passed the Emmett Till Anti Lynching Act. We need real leaders who will put forth practical solutions to solve problems not sit on their hands or play politics to stay in power. [We will only make progress if we speak up, unite, organize, vote, pass laws, and hold our leaders accountable. We cannot do that without your help. We have to literally put our money where our mouths are. Will you join me?](https://www.jhtforcongress.com/so/43OEGDKtq/c?w=y6pgw6uuES08AbUgIERusHoHGeBVV7n-JmZjvN4_O0U.eyJ1IjoiaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYWN0Ymx1ZS5jb20vZG9uYXRlL2podGZvcmNvbmdyZXNzIiwiciI6ImIwMDRjMDcwLTg2M2ItNGFlOC0yMDg2LTY5NzVlZTM5N2Y3YiIsIm0iOiJtYWlsIiwiYyI6IjVkNzQ5ZGQ1LTFiYTMtNDU2OS1hODVlLWE5NjUzNzU0NDNhNSJ9)

| Hi there,

With ballots already in the mail, Michiganders have begun voting in this critical election. And with less than 40 days until Election Day, we don’t have a moment to lose in our efforts to reach every voter so they know about Dan's work to lower costs for families and bring good-paying, union jobs to mid-Michigan.

**[These and so many more issues are at stake in November, and we want to make sure you have a plan to vote and hear why you are motivated to vote this year. Will you be one of the first 1,000 supporters to complete our two-minute survey within 48 hours?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52052115/371073367/-418345834?refcode=EM_NBI_DK_20221005_SV_prioritiesSV.1.1_0_3MO_campaign_NA_NA_prioritiesSV&utm_source=em_nbi_dk_20221005_sv_prioritiessv.1.1_0_3mo_campaign_na_na_prioritiessv&source=EM_NBI_DK_20221005_SV_prioritiesSV.1.1_0_3MO_campaign_NA_NA_prioritiesSV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjg4MDhkYi0wNzQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uMWnga3t6EoLkCnF9TZZT4eOoy5FjozoEa0S1tfZmPE=&emci=2dc9efd3-0745-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=c68808db-0745-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=31479900)**

Just a handful of seats are true “toss-up” races, and the polls have made it clear that our race is one of the most competitive ones in the entire country. We must hold onto this seat, or all of our important work will be in jeopardy.

**[That’s why we want to hear from you. Be one of the first 1,000 supporters to fill out our survey and let us know if you are planning to vote and why you are motivated to go to the polls this year.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52052119/371073371/-418345834?refcode=EM_NBI_DK_20221005_SV_prioritiesSV.1.1_0_3MO_campaign_NA_NA_prioritiesSV&utm_source=em_nbi_dk_20221005_sv_prioritiessv.1.1_0_3mo_campaign_na_na_prioritiessv&source=EM_NBI_DK_20221005_SV_prioritiesSV.1.1_0_3MO_campaign_NA_NA_prioritiesSV&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83Nzg3NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNjg4MDhkYi0wNzQ1LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uMWnga3t6EoLkCnF9TZZT4eOoy5FjozoEa0S1tfZmPE=&emci=2dc9efd3-0745-ed11-b495-002248258d38&emdi=c68808db-0745-ed11-b495-002248258d38&ceid=31479900)**

Thanks for sharing your input,
Team Kildee

name: Tiffany Smiley
subject: My story in pictures 👉
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Smiley for Washington, Inc
body:
| |
---
| | | Peter,

My name is Tiffany Smiley and I wanted to tell you a little bit about myself and why I'm running for the U.S. Senate in Washington.

I grew up in Pasco, Washington where I helped out on my family's farm and learned the value of hard work.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "I helped out on my family’s farm and learned the value of
hard work.")
---

I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College, where I also studied to become a nurse so I could pursue my passion of helping others in need.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "I went on to play soccer at Whitworth College")
---

I married my high school sweetheart Scotty, who went on to serve our country in the United States Army while I started my nursing career.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "I married my high school sweetheart Scotty")
---

In 2005, I received a call that changed both our lives forever, Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq, causing him to fall into a coma and permanently lose sight in both of his eyes.

I immediately booked a flight for Walter Reed Medical Center to be by Scotty's side.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Scotty was severely wounded by a suicide bomber in Iraq")
---

When I arrived, Scotty was still in trauma care, and I was informed that he would never be able to serve his nation again in uniform. They even asked me to sign a document, right there on the spot, consenting to Scotty's immediate discharge from the Army.
_**I refused. **_
Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Since that day I've made it my mission to ensure Scotty, and
every veteran gets the benefits and care they earned.")
---

Scotty went on to serve as America's first blind active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Scotty went on to serve as America’s first blind
active-duty Army officer, breaking barriers for many who followed along the way. ")
---

It's not every day you hear about American women going up against the U.S. Military. But we defied the government in a big way--_and won._

We stood up to a broken bureaucracy because it was the right thing to do. I will always stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "I will always
stand up for our heroes and continue being an advocate for our veterans in the U.S. Senate.")
---

In 2007, we welcomed our first child. While Scotty will never be able to 'see' our children's faces, he's always been an incredible father and hero to our boys.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "In 2007, we welcomed our first child.")
---

Now, our family is taking on a new challenge. I'm running for US Senate to help families across the country achieve the American Dream and save our country from Joe Biden and Patty Murray.

I will take the same fight and optimistic spirit I've shown throughout my life to help Washington families secure a better life. I believe that now, more than ever, Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.

---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Washingtonians need a voice to find solutions to their unique problems and end the partisan gridlock in Congress.")
---

My family began this journey in the halls of Walter Reed and we look forward to continuing this journey in the halls of the United States Capitol.

I would love for the next photo in this story to be us winning this race with my family by my side.

We can't do that, however, without your help, friend. _**[So please, can you chip in just a few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we've achieved so far.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "So please, can you chip in just a
few bucks to help us keep up the momentum we’ve achieved so far. ")**_

---
| | | [KEEP TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "KEEP
TIFFANY IN THE FIGHT")
---
| | | [STAND UP FOR AMERICA](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518500:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "STAND UP FOR AMERICA")
---

I know with your support we can win this.

Sincerely,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| |

---
* * *
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518501:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "All
Eyes On Washington")
---
Hey, it's Tiffany Smiley.

The Washington Senate race is now the #1 battleground race in the COUNTRY!

Needless to say, all eyes are on us. We are in the FINAL DAYS until the November election, and Patty Murray is flooding millions into our state.

We are in an uphill battle, and I can't make it up to the top without you. Not just Washingtonians, but all Americans deserve a real leader with real solutions. Together, we can ensure that the American Dream is not lost.

_**[Rush support now to be a part of history](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518501:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Rush support now to be a part of
history")**_.

Let's raise money and WIN,

Tiffany Smiley

---
| | | [JOIN TEAM SMILEY](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518501:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "JOIN TEAM
SMILEY")
---
| [](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518502:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Alert!")
---

Team Smiley here with a RED ALERT!

You know we don't often beg, plead, or panic, but Tiffany is facing a key deadline, and we're OUT of time.

Whether or not you choose to act will decide the outcome of the Washington U.S. Senate Election:

Tiffany is currently being outraised and outspent by her 30-year incumbent opponent. We need all hands on deck to turn things around TODAY.

There's no time to wait on the sidelines.

_**[That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518503:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "That's why we're HUMBLY asking for your help in the next 15 minutes!")**_

This is our only chance to make history and restore a brighter future for Washington and all of America. We need Tiffany Smiley in the U.S. Senate, plain and simple.

Our team doesn't want to have to deliver bad news to Tiffany later today, so we're calling on our grassroots team, including YOU, to help increase our momentum!

Tiffany is a veterans' advocate and mother of 3! She is the new, fresh leadership we desperately need in Washington! Tiffany will be your #1 supporter in the U.S. Senate.

We're out of time. There's nowhere else to turn. Tiffany needs us at this moment. _**[Step up now!](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518503:6b6vy_VfN:m:1:3317145305:067A5C316F28CF36AA518F4A69E1E102:r "Step up
now!")**_

body:
[](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f32ae8c942cf4ad8979f6225f9f02268&_e=x246qhzRu-5MbuvUhBiLRPsiYmRC-aMQ2UqDIz3VKUn5l8kYHXhyVO87yJbKsYcrY2L8qAjxVNblHkvRXVW6oqyx0FHI0g06w9-V6cuIWx8ODu2UN5Zrr0KV840j734KzZ3jcE0b63r13YCZZrXf-UP0cWlDUOFNK42GMwknP8VAmgUfKdQnXvpdw5tbrnBydthZ3HUf9D1DP2wpbNrkiem0sOwWgBoRz5hLVLyANuHBBUThmoRcHTlfSU8fdxSY5IfBH6fMP5A6nFYd-INQ0_p3v25MlCTDZigOq_Glb58%3D)
Friend,

Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to **sell?**

Because that’s exactly what happened — Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release!

**It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic.**
What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex?

If that disgusts you, here’s where it gets worse. _It worked_. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she’s still selling sex.

She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you’re willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more.

**Is this the example we want to leave for our children?**

At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence.

My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance.

I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don’t have to be like the Kardashians to be successful.

[**Can you support this critical mission with a gift of $10, $25, or even $50? Click here to donate today >>>**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f32ae8c942cf4ad8979f6225f9f02268&_e=x246qhzRu-5MbuvUhBiLRPsiYmRC-aMQ2UqDIz3VKUn5l8kYHXhyVO87yJbKsYcrY2L8qAjxVNblHkvRXVW6oqyx0FHI0g06w9-V6cuIWx8ODu2UN5Zrr0KV840j734KzZ3jcE0b63r13YCZZrXf-T5mvRKBeCk7qySx22Fijl_VooxjdskWqKcJosBHrtl132LcxOar1hcG0xRYHbSzhVLNbDHOyK_02myRWHS8KjcEpEOlyXBg5HttNulQGgnIlXVCfUcRW9b0t_sFLfDzV8DSs027VCEKB2TC-5sha94%3D)

BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters.

Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events.

They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies.

Just this summer, **BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people.** They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration.

**BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children** for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp.

The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland!

Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program – Liberation Camp – for 80 children.

_BLEXIT’s Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative_.

The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter **distributed over 400 school supplies** and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago’s most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to **give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags.**

BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America’s minority communities.

[**We currently have 42 chapters across the US and more than 14,000 volunteers! You can help BLEXIT support our State Chapters by donating $10, $25, $50, or any other amount today. Click here to send your gift >>>**](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=f32ae8c942cf4ad8979f6225f9f02268&_e=x246qhzRu-5MbuvUhBiLRPsiYmRC-aMQ2UqDIz3VKUn5l8kYHXhyVO87yJbKsYcrY2L8qAjxVNblHkvRXVW6oqyx0FHI0g06w9-V6cuIWx8ODu2UN5Zrr0KV840j734KzZ3jcE0b63r13YCZZrXf-YBEwJU1AKSVOqYPlGAgBQUDRbbE6IfjPS_1vurzyBuO4nZSOyP5Bi6aJ7BrDzm_akScOqT99e-YHkQDnY4s5JKQvPMrxiHEwF-ftKXUbKHD8n4D6b_OhGd0XQzuuL3UE041qWlAHVpDAVemvK0v4EU%3D)

BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities.

These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them.

But here’s the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community:

* They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities.

* They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers.

* They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves.

**These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.**

BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can’t do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000?
