clean_body: Friend, Would you believe me if I said that a mother watched videos of her daughter having sex with her boyfriend and picked which one her daughter looked best in to sell? Because that’s exactly what happened — Kris Jenner watched AND hand-picked which sex tape her daughter Kim Kardashian would release! It is not an exaggeration to say that Hollywood is satanic. What could possibly be more satanic than a mother using her daughter's body to sell sex? If that disgusts you, here’s where it gets worse. It worked. Kim Kardashian is a billionaire, and she’s still selling sex. She is symbolic of the society we live in today. That if you are willing to degrade yourself, if you’re willing to denigrate yourself, then our society will give you more. Is this the example we want to leave for our children? At BLEXIT, we believe families should be grounded in faith and honor and respect their children and protect their innocence. My name is Candace Owens, co-founder of the BLEXIT Foundation. BLEXIT focuses on educating minorities about the history of our great country, the principles of the Constitution, and the importance of self-reliance. I’ve set a goal to raise $50,000 by the end of the month to show the next generation that they don’t have to be like the Kardashians to be successful. BLEXIT is bringing pro-America, pro-Family values to Black and minority communities through the work of our State Chapters. Our Chapters spread the universal principles of the BLEXIT movement at the local level through community service, social engagement, educational activities, and virtual events. They demonstrate how people can escape the mentality of victimhood and empower others to take control of their destinies. Just this summer, BLEXIT-Fest in New Jersey introduced our message to over 400 people. They had a variety of talented performers and speakers and created a memorable community celebration. BLEXIT chapter members from our Tampa, FL, and North Charleston, SC sites educated and cared for approximately 80 children for six weeks during our full-day Summer Camp. The children in our Tampa program even took a field trip to Legoland! Now that school has started, these BLEXIT chapters are providing an after-school youth education program – Liberation Camp – for 80 children. BLEXIT’s Chapters are a huge part of our Back to School initiative. The BLEXIT Illinois Chapter distributed over 400 school supplies and BLEXIT merchandise in one of Chicago’s most impoverished communities. The NY Chapter was fortunate to give away 120 school supply kits as well as 40 book bags. BLEXIT Chapters are changing the narrative that surrounds America’s minority communities. BLEXIT is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence reinforced by groups that market themselves as serving the Black community, such as Black Lives Matter, but in actuality, they destroy communities. These organizations are poisoning minority communities. They tell these bright young men and women they are victims of systematic repression and that their skin color is all that defines them. But here’s the ugly truth about other organizations who claim to serve the Black community: They claim to support Black communities. . . but they fan the flames of riots and violence that directly impact the lives of the people in those communities. They claim to fight for criminal justice reform. . . but they teach Black men and women to hate and disrespect police officers. They claim to be a non-profit group fighting for Black men and women. . . but they use donor funds to enrich themselves. These other organizations are destroying Black communities, dividing our country, and forcing a message of victimhood and hatred down the throats of minorities.** BLEXIT is countering their hateful narrative, but we can’t do it alone, Friend. Can you donate to BLEXIT today and help us reach our goal of raising $50,000? - Thank you, Candace Owens Co-Founder & President BLEXIT Foundation BLEXIT is a 501(c)3 tax-exempt organization. subject: Montana NOW to host events for Penny Ronning across MT-02
body:
Join Montana NOW and Penny in Helena, Livingston, or Billings! | |
---
| | |
---
| | | Peter Willis

I am proud to be endorsed by the National NOW PAC and join them on their tour across Montana in Helena, Livingston, and Billings to discuss what's at stake for this upcoming election!
---
| _**Join us in Helena, MT**_
---
|
Montana NOW will be hosting a forum called, **"What's at Stake? Our Reproductive Rights, Health and Bodily Autonomy". **

The forum will be held this week on _**Saturday, Oct. 8, 2022, from 1 p.m. to 2:30 p.m. at the Lewis and Clark Library (120 S. Last Chance Gulch St., Helena, MT 59601)**_.

It will also be recorded via zoom. Please find the link and details below. [Zoom meeting link](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=374dd161ed&e=2f4ec52c5e): NO NEED TO PRE-REGISTER The forum will feature **Bear Atwood, the Vice President of the National Organization for Women**. Prior to becoming Vice President, she was a civil rights lawyer in Jackson, Mississippi specializing in representing LGBT clients. She is the former Legal Director for the ACLU of Mississippi and was the Executive Director for the Southern Poverty Law Center’s youth justice project. Prior to moving to Mississippi, Bear was a Deputy Attorney General in New Jersey working for the State’s Division on Civil Rights. She has also worked for Planned Parenthood of Central New Jersey. Bear is the current President of Mississippi NOW and a former President of NOW-NJ. She was a member of the NOW National Board and has served on the PAC.
---
|
---
| Immediately following the forum there will be a Meet and Greet event at the _**10 Mile Creek Brewery (48 N. Last Chance Gulch, Helena, MT 59601) at 3 PM**_ for Montana NOW's endorsed candidates, including Mary Ann Dunwell, Jill Cohenour and myself.

_**Come pick up Postcards for Penny at this event to help get voters to the polls to protect women’s rights across Montana!**_
---
|
---
| _**Join us in Livingston, MT **_
---
|
Montana NOW will be hosting another Meet and Greet in Livingston, MT, featuring Bear Atwood, the Vice President of the National Organization for Women.

_**The event is on Sunday, Oct. 9, 2022, at 3 p.m. at the Shane Center for the Performing Arts (415 E. Lewis St., Livingston, MT 59047) and features the Jazz Duo of Frances Stewart and Bob Nell. **_

---
|
---
| _**Join us in Billings, MT**_
---
|
Finally, there will be a Meet and Greet event in Billings hosted by Montana NOW and Kiely and Rich Lammers, featuring Vice President Bear Atwood.

_**The event in on Monday, Oct. 10, 2022, from 5-6:30 p.m. RSVP to (208) 794.1513 for the address and to attend.**_
---
|
---
| **I have had a career centered around public service and came from a family that knew the value of hard work. I have carried that ethic into everything I do, including running for Congress.** As a former Billings City Councilwoman, I have championed issues such as fighting for families, women and children, public safety, and economic development.** Finally, I have a proven record of representing the people and will continue to do so once elected. **

For more information visit [pennyronning.com](https://pennyronning.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=05c2d51066158a4f5219d9967&id=153220467c&e=2f4ec52c5e).

---
| | | Hi, I'm Adam Laxalt, and this is my story.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518407:JdWWb_VAN:m:1:3331421248:5B7FCC4A72A5A66D34756E636A6DF61D:r "Adam 1")
---

I didn't know who my father was. I was born to a single mother in the 1970s. She was in her early 20s, had no college degree, and faced enormous pressure to not bring me into this world. But through faith, she chose to give me the chance to live, and I'll be forever grateful for that opportunity.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518407:JdWWb_VAN:m:1:3331421248:5B7FCC4A72A5A66D34756E636A6DF61D:r "Adam 2")
---

Although my childhood wasn't always easy, my experiences shaped me into the person I am today. I learned the power of faith and the importance of family and community. Without these things, there is no way I could've accomplished everything that I have.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518407:JdWWb_VAN:m:1:3331421248:5B7FCC4A72A5A66D34756E636A6DF61D:r "Adam 3")
---

After 9/11 attacks, I joined the US Navy - I always knew I wanted to serve my country, but after that date, I knew I needed to act. As a Naval Officer and Iraq Veteran, I served in detainee operations and assisted in the detention and prosecution of more than 20,000 detainees.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518407:JdWWb_VAN:m:1:3331421248:5B7FCC4A72A5A66D34756E636A6DF61D:r "Adam 4")
---

Nothing made me prouder than keeping my fellow Americans safe by assisting with the prosecution of thousands of war criminals and terrorists.

After finishing my active duty service, I decided to get married and start my family. But I knew I wasn't done serving and protecting our country. In 2015, I became Nevada's Attorney General, where I fought against President Obama by suing over federal overreach. I fought for the Constitution.

---
| [](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518407:JdWWb_VAN:m:1:3331421248:5B7FCC4A72A5A66D34756E636A6DF61D:r "Adam 5")
---

Today I live in Reno with my wife, Jaime, and four kids. They're the reason I'm running for US Senate.

I believe our country is fighting a battle between good and evil, and right now it seems the wrong side is winning. But I believe America is worth saving, and I know you do too.

_**[That's why I'm asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in Washington.](http://email.vervemail.com/ct/61518407:JdWWb_VAN:m:1:3331421248:5B7FCC4A72A5A66D34756E636A6DF61D:r "That’s why I’m asking you to join my team and fight with me to restore conservative leadership in
Washington.")**_ Together we can take this country back, but we must act now. Please, step up now before it's too late.

---

I know with your support, we can save this country we both love so much.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Adam Laxalt

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY THE NATIONAL REDISTRICTING ACTION FUND
body:
We’ve been fighting this fight since our existence.
|
---

Friend,

History has shown us that fighting for the promise of a free and fair democracy does not happen in a singular moment. The civil rights movement has marched forward and advocated for change time and time again, generation after generation. Our moment for action has come. We are at the front line advocating for this very promise. **Yesterday, the moment for Black voters in Alabama was no different.**

On Tuesday, October 4, 2022, the U.S. Supreme Court heard oral argument in _Merrill v. Milligan_. This case is an ongoing challenge to Alabama's new congressional district map, which a lower court found likely violated Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (VRA) and diluted Black voting power. The district court directed the state to draw a new congressional map that would provide Black voters with two districts that would allow them the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice.

Alabama immediately appealed the trial court's decision to the U.S. Supreme Court. In a 5-4 decision, the Court blocked the remedial map-drawing process ordered by the lower court. As a result, Alabama voters will have to vote under the state’s discriminatory congressional map in the 2022 election -- a map that is unfair and not representative of Alabamians.
[**All On The Line has worked tirelessly for the past years to encourage states to make their redistricting process fair and transparent. Will you contribute to supporting our work to fight for the inclusion of communities that have been excluded in the past and need a voice in states like Alabama?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52053622/371100778/1288077260?refcode=20221005_AOTL_F_SCOTUS1_actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3YmUwY2UxLTEyNDUtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qwr0xROLvTaezTJEcvuZ4xUcJXSRtXuqV55CtqS88Bc=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_

[**If the Supreme Court overturns the lower court’s decision, the consequences will be immediate and severe.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/52053629/371100785/1288077260?refcode=20221005_AOTL_F_SCOTUS1_actives&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk2IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjM3YmUwY2UxLTEyNDUtZWQxMS1iNDk1LTAwMjI0ODI1OGQzOCIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=qwr0xROLvTaezTJEcvuZ4xUcJXSRtXuqV55CtqS88Bc=) This could effectively remove significant protections against racial vote dilution and will set back the VRA's voting protections for communities of color across the country.

The National Redistricting Foundation, a 501(c)(3) affiliate of All On The Line, is supporting the _Merrill v. Milligan_ case to fight for the ability of Black Alabamians to elect representatives of their choice and have their voices heard.

**The right to vote and elect your representative is a founding ideal of this nation. When we allow our ideals to be diluted, we are no longer representative of our strengths but giving into our greatest weaknesses, as a nation.**

This was not just a run-of-the-mill hearing on October 4. This was a moment to recommit to the fight for a free and fair democracy. When we see this egregious behavior, like Alabama in _Merrill v. Milligan_ , we recommit ourselves to the long battle for freedom and fairness. This is democracy. clean_body: We’ve been fighting this fight since our existence. | Friend, History has shown us that fighting for the promise of a free and fair democracy does not happen in a singular moment. The civil rights movement has marched forward and advocated for change time and time again, generation after generation. Our moment for action has come. We are at the front line advocating for this very promise. Yesterday, the moment for Black voters in Alabama was no different. On Tuesday, October 4, 2022, the U.S. Supreme Court heard oral argument in Merrill v. Milligan. This case is an ongoing challenge to Alabama's new congressional district map, which a lower court found likely violated Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act (VRA) and diluted Black voting power. The district court directed the state to draw a new congressional map that would provide Black voters with two districts that would allow them the opportunity to elect candidates of their choice. Alabama immediately appealed the trial court's decision to the U.S. Supreme Court. In a 5-4 decision, the Court blocked the remedial map-drawing process ordered by the lower court. As a result, Alabama voters will have to vote under the state’s discriminatory congressional map in the 2022 election -- a map that is unfair and not representative of Alabamians. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = = This could effectively remove significant protections against racial vote dilution and will set back the VRA's voting protections for communities of color across the country. The National Redistricting Foundation, a 501(c)(3) affiliate of All On The Line, is supporting the Merrill v. Milligan case to fight for the ability of Black Alabamians to elect representatives of their choice and have their voices heard. The right to vote and elect your representative is a founding ideal of this nation. When we allow our ideals to be diluted, we are no longer representative of our strengths but giving into our greatest weaknesses, as a nation. This was not just a run-of-the-mill hearing on October 4. This was a moment to recommit to the fight for a free and fair democracy. When we see this egregious behavior, like Alabama in Merrill v. Milligan , we recommit ourselves to the long battle for freedom and fairness. This is democracy. We can't lose sight of this moment and how it impacts the promise of our nation’s fight toward a fair and just democracy. = Olivia Mendoza, Deputy Director Litigation and Policy All On The Line is the grassroots advocacy campaign supported by the National Redistricting Action Fund. _**NOW:**_ Our candidates are fighting harder than ever, but it's become an uphill battle. Democrats have SURGED ahead in the polls, thanks to their influx of elitist cash from Hollywood donors.

This is a very fluid situation. To avoid any potential conflict or compromise of other ongoing cases, I need to stay quiet a little longer. We will continue to post our official statements as more news breaks. And I will be back on LIVE to explain everything very soon. To those of you who’ve supported our work for years on end, thank you. Your faith is a constant source of encouragement to us. To our detractors, so be it. We’re fighting to keep our elections secure and our nation free. Lastly, we should all recognize this as an opportunity to unify. Wherever you are on the political spectrum, let’s come together to protect our country. Keep the faith. I’ll be back in touch again very soon. This is a Psalms 35 moment. Thanks be to God. body:
[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

With fair elections and abortion rights on
the ballot, it’s critical we stop an increasingly fascist Republican Party
from seizing power.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1011&akid=3489%2E5885482%2ETePRnY ]Can we count on you to volunteer to make calls between now and Election
Day? Even one shift is a huge help!

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1012&akid=3489%2E5885482%2ETePRnY ]VOLUNTEER

It’s only through people power that we can overcome big money to elect
allies at every level of government and change the political landscape. If
we don’t get involved, big money wins.

We have a targeted list to maximize the impact of our Phonebank operation.
Even if you’ve never made calls before, our crew will be there to help
every step of the way. It’s fun and easy, and it’s just a great place to
gather with like-minded folks to make a difference.

We’re calling for John Fetterman, Mandela Barnes, Keith Ellison, Megan
Green and many more excellent candidates up and down the ballot.

Down-Ballot races are crucial because these are the seats closer to the
people and the issues.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4972?t=1013&akid=3489%2E5885482%2ETePRnY ]If you’re worried about a red wave or a MAGA majority taking power in
November, this is the way you can make the biggest impact on the outcome
of the election. Can we count on you to volunteer?

We’ve made more than 800,000 calls so far in the midterms — clinching
primary wins and sending a lot of progressives to the general election. We
want to hit more than a million calls by Election Day, November 8!

In solidarity,

Our Revolution

Fellow American,

At 17 years old, I dropped out of high school and started waitressing at the local Waffle House to put food on the table.

Like a lot of Americans, I struggled to make ends meet, living paycheck to paycheck as I also worked to earn my high school diploma taking classes at a technical college. I got by _without_ government handouts or radical socialist policies – and I am a better woman because of it.

[ ](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=f7ad4c3bff7c45ce91f7fcdb92c38ef8&_e=DH1uQYxhFcjDYDDUGY_uOMn85Onz5FLs7-vnMbX7Sc7q-OjVpIEFxIfulxVu8MajosLIFMRESkcC9jO525SZoUU_fsOI75oAwpl5BRp0J0rV378KxQYzBUFygbZBSStBcF9_EglZ1n9jO8uxrne0R3kdHjxY_dp9EClRtdlZW3rYbXCvgqy2KiirC5svQ3Fs0QsFSxEgoeiC-UtMIT0ooC51juhSPzPwf6KnPk3tkz-go9GH4V3wLvgGW_dUNeUZZcedsEtS4JnFkVxBJ7d_6zloFozJk-TZCxYvmMBmXex-yT3uTKD2zV0E_IiESPbVijQCWS7VldCSey2q1eXoPqhDcks0BCpjz7jx6tVupo623YNxuJGSA8GQDHJoPlYSbk0xNX9Qusn9du_VRvBIHA%3D%3D)

I went from Waffle House to Washington, with a few stops in between, but my first job taught me many lessons I use in Congress to this day: _the value of hard-work, kindness, and perseverance._

[**I’m running for re-election**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=f7ad4c3bff7c45ce91f7fcdb92c38ef8&_e=DH1uQYxhFcjDYDDUGY_uOMn85Onz5FLs7-vnMbX7Sc7q-OjVpIEFxIfulxVu8MajosLIFMRESkcC9jO525SZoUU_fsOI75oAwpl5BRp0J0rV378KxQYzBUFygbZBSStBcF9_EglZ1n9jO8uxrne0R3kdHjxY_dp9EClRtdlZW3rYbXCvgqy2KiirC5svQ3Fs0QsFSxEgoeiC-UtMIT0ooC51juhSPzPwf6KnPk3tkz-go9GH4V3wLvgGW_dUNeUZkERMzAfpMw4g0mGplOZW5epZ8D0FonVRxBUsWfcegeEAxh955xUPM3pWmUNR1DjIs2_YiCYKf_zYhOX8HNjFSfT8qL6h4PMY-6zSH24B-bMgHFnC3be3QolXCLCwrpnYn92ewLZ5bJxOfvmJTfxwlA%3D%3D) because I understand the real problems American families are dealing with and how to find sustainable solutions. I didn’t grow up with millions in the bank, and a silver spoon in my mouth. My dad was an Army General and my mom a schoolteacher. My parents taught me the key to success, **work**.

And working is what I’ve been doing since I was 17.

Congress is in desperate need of people like me – someone who understands having to make the choice between gas or groceries because you only have enough dollar bills in your wallet to cover one or the other. Someone who knows what it’s like to earn a living and make sacrifices.

[**It’s people like you and me who should be representing America – not the liberal-elites who are used to always getting their way (or buying their way).**](http://links.ourbestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=80ebb41732384ac087921d8b617f32bf&_m=f7ad4c3bff7c45ce91f7fcdb92c38ef8&_e=DH1uQYxhFcjDYDDUGY_uOMn85Onz5FLs7-vnMbX7Sc7q-OjVpIEFxIfulxVu8MajosLIFMRESkcC9jO525SZoUU_fsOI75oAwpl5BRp0J0rV378KxQYzBUFygbZBSStBcF9_EglZ1n9jO8uxrne0R3kdHjxY_dp9EClRtdlZW3rYbXCvgqy2KiirC5svQ3Fs0QsFSxEgoeiC-UtMIT0ooC51juhSPzPwf6KnPk3tkz-go9GH4V3wLvgGW_dUNeUZiAI_betfaYFdXJ5Po187JOusut8HT4afuwBrdwsb7UNAjmKkK9bBtJqhPGCp304QFkQW05_v6TBe-VXxUb4KRFFW7uXWuXANRJJxfn0Ir421h0KGoMgF3BeI6f4UiOQG_44xOtTUMasOhK1beL0uXA%3D%3D)

body:
| We’re getting down to the wire.

With the last voter registration deadline Monday and early voting just 2 weeks away, the window of opportunity for us to make sure each and every Lowcountry voter knows the truth about Nancy Mace is closing.

I want to talk to you about the serious threats Mace has made in this race along with her discriminatory and just plain bad policies. But first, I have to ask you to chip in and support my campaign in the final 5 weeks until Election Day. **[Click here to ensure we can defeat my opponent.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/52041307/371066959/-138032517?amount=15&source=EM_NBI_AA_20221005_FR_1.1_0_3MO_candidate_NA_NA_MaceAttacks&refcode2=&contactdata=AlzXRTWii1/pYcWQgNSxna3nhrO3Odefxa6LF9QKNYgWECQlqHYOHi0mcb+W+f1z&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85Mzk0MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNjkwNWQ1NS1mZjQ0LWVkMTEtYjQ5NS0wMDIyNDgyNThkMzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=X7QWH2u-ONtL_dDzp6sgKxFpI7hCs7eNSdBd86KE7mg=)**

Just this week, the American Medical Association, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and the Children's Hospital Association sent a letter to the Department of Justice urging them to investigate the disturbing threats politicians like Nancy Mace have made against my coworkers and me. Her unfounded claims that we’re doing sex changes on children have shocked the medical community and now they’re speaking out against these abhorrent attacks.

Her unfounded claims that we’re doing gender-affirming care for children have shocked the medical community and now they’re speaking out against these abhorrent attacks. **The fear-mongering that Nancy Mace engaged in is increasing threats of violence against hard-working medical professionals.**

_That’s how serious her false allegations of “child abuse” in her attack ads are. This isn’t just politics as usual. What she’s saying about me in order to score political points with her extreme base is deeply personal and dangerous._

| | **2022 October e-newsletter**
**All county cities on track to become ‘Age Friendly’ **
Dear friends, I want to offer a special thanks to all in our community who have participated on the county’s journey to have all of our cities designated “Age-Friendly” communities by the World Health Organization. We are now in the fifth year of this endeavor and it’s been a privilege to see the partnership between the county and the Center for Age Friendly Excellence to help our cities become age-friendly certified. Five years ago, this journey started with Redwood City, Daly City and Pacifica in a pilot program that has now spread across the entire county. Currently 12 cities are certified with Atherton, East Palo Alto, Menlo Park, Portola Valley and South San Francisco headed toward certification in 2023. Just recently both Millbrae and Belmont received the certification from WHO. Special thanks to Anabel Pelham at CAFÉ for many years of service to the county on helping us reach this milestone, which we celebrated at a summit at Skyline College in September. Former state Senator Jerry Hill acted as master of ceremonies and guided representatives from each city who shared community organizing process of focus group research, project development and plans for the future. Keynote speaker Sutep Laohavanich, Deputy Director of the California Department of Aging, outlined an update of the state’s Master Plan on Aging and I had the honor to share the history, vision and importance of the age-friendly cities initiative as a vital public policy for the demographic changes in California. As many of you know our county is rapidly aging. By 2030, it is estimated that 30 percent of the county’s population will be over the age of 65. San Mateo County has been committed to supporting older adults as they take charge of their health, explore new opportunities and activities and focus on independence, especially during the pandemic. We are transforming San Mateo County forever into a caring community that encourages people of all ages to live active lives and I hope we can continue to strive toward that goal. I’d like to share a quote from George Bernard Shaw who said: “We don’t stop playing because we grow old. We grow old because we stop playing.” To learn more go to: [http://cfafe.org/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=c84b63bb51&e=c0babbc643) **New bivalent booster recommended for everyone 12+** With new Omicron variants of COVID-19 spreading through the community, it is recommended for everyone 12 and older to get the new bivalent booster, which replaces previous booster recommendations. But according to our county Health System, only 6 percent or 43,429 county residents have received the updated COVID-19 booster. With that in mind, the county is offering the updated booster at clinics throughout the county and I encourage you all to take that shot to keep your family protected from this still circulating disease. A list of clinics and schedules can be found here [https://www.smchealth.org/vaccine-clinic-calendar](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=82ffa68cfd&e=c0babbc643) and no appointments are necessary. Broader health care systems – primary care practices and pharmacies across the county – are also offering the updated booster. At many pharmacy locations, you can make an appointment same day or next day, and at some locations flu shots can be obtained during the same visit. The updated COVID-19 boosters are currently available for those ages 12 and older, and we anticipate that these updated boosters will be available later this month for children ages 5 to 11, according to the county’s Health System.. The county will continue to offer weekly standing COVID-19 vaccine clinics in East Palo Alto, North Fair Oaks, San Mateo, Half Moon Bay, South San Francisco, and Daly City through the end of October. **New mural highlights benefits of public art**

I was proud to join Jefferson High School’s GrizzArt Club as it celebrated the completion of its first mural with a ribbon-cutting ceremony last month at Daly City Mitsubishi at the intersection of Mission Street and Hillside Boulevard.

The recently-completed mural is the result of a collaboration between Victoria Magbilang, project funder Dragonfly Community Arts, and the Bay Area Mural Program (BAMP), who worked with the GrizzArt students and their advisor Suzanne Koehnlein to design and paint this exciting new Daly City landmark. This new 2,000-square-foot mural was created and envisioned by art club students at Jefferson High School in Daly City that imitates a vintage postcard and celebrates life in Daly City, showcasing foggy, hillside neighborhoods and iconic Daly City locations and imagery.

The ambitious project was a partnership between Dragonfly Community Arts, Bay Area Mural Program (BAMP), Jefferson High School, and Daly City leaders and community members. The project got its start in the Fall of 2021, when Dragonfly Community Arts connected with Victoria Magbilang, executive director of the Daly City Public Library Associates and current San Mateo County Arts Commissioner, about the need for public art in Daly City. The idea was to not only find a way to bring public art to the city, but to also educate and inspire young artists. Dragonfly looked no further than Jefferson High School and Bay Area Mural Program. The art club at Jefferson is student-led and meets weekly after school to explore new art opportunities and for students to learn from each other and explore their creativity. The mural is awesome and I encourage everyone to check it out. Our community needs more partnerships like this to expand public art.
**County budget reflects values of ending homelessness, offering assistance to those in need during pandemic** The San Mateo County Board of Supervisors approved a $4.2 billion revised budget for fiscal year 2022-23 last month that focuses on ending homelessness, continuing economic recovery from the pandemic and advancing social justice and equity. The revised budget calls for an increase of $791.2 million over the recommended budget the Board considered in June. The increase is fueled in large part by unanticipated growth in property taxes, particularly in the commercial sector, and sales taxes, along with the infusion of federal and state funds to assist with COVID-19 recovery. With a 20 percent increase in homelessness since the pandemic started, this Board has made historic investments to house and support our most vulnerable residents. The goal to reach functional zero homelessness is becoming within reach and this budget reflects the Board’s values to make sure that no one is left behind. The budget also includes increased support for food assistance, rental assistance and basic needs as inflation is having a huge impact on the working poor. Food prices are up nearly 11 percent and gas prices are up by 36 percent and we are seeing more and more people relying on credit to survive and many of had to dip into whatever meager savings they might have. I am proud that this budget includes increased support for food assistance, rental assistance, and basic needs. However, we must be prepared to offer additional relief to some in our community if the impacts of inflation continue. To see the budget go here: [https://www.smcgov.org/ceo/budget-publications](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=5750ea1c1e&e=c0babbc643) **Battling food insecurity **
Food insecurity is a problem some residents may still face as we continue to emerge from the pandemic. Here are some resources residents can access: **CalFresh:**
Is a program for people with low-income who meet federal income eligibility rules and want to add to their budget to put healthy and nutritious food on the table. Website: [https://www.cdss.ca.gov/food-nutrition/calfresh](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=6a611a2d1b&e=c0babbc643) Contact: (650) 802-6576, [antorres@smcgov.org](mailto:antorres@smcgov.org) **Daly City Partnership:**
DC Partnership is a local partnership that was formed to guide collaborative efforts and connect our community to services that promote well-being. Check out their website for times and locations. Website: [https://www.dcpartnership.org/covid19/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=a0c8489032&e=c0babbc643) **Second Harvest Food Bank:**
Second Harvest offers food at various locations throughout San Mateo County listed on its webpage. Website: [https://www.shfb.org/get-food/](https://davidcanepa.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c7592558e548bc8cc150aa5&id=2c97f2173a&e=c0babbc643) Contacts: Call (800) 984-3663 or text GETFOOD to (408) 455-5181 **Interns wanted to join our team **

We are looking to add to our great group of interns we are currently working with. If you or someone you know may be interested in applying to my Internship Program, submitting this form is the first step: https://forms.gle/hiKqtn7Rird5vXwB9. You can also reach out to Mike Richardson on my staff directly with any questions at mrichardson@smcgov.org In friendship, David J. Canepa

subject: Dem leaders just blew our last chance
body:
It’s really pretty simple.
#
Peter,
As of last year, Nancy Pelosi is estimated to have a net worth of $46,000,000. **She is the 15th wealthiest member in all of Congress.** And just a few days ago, she oversaw the process that ultimately killed the ban on stock trading for all members of Congress. Funny how that works.
It must pay to invest in mega-corporations like Apple, Amazon, Meta, Tesla, and Microsoft – **Nancy has no interest in providing for us when she can profit for herself.**
Thanks to Justice Democrat Pramila Jayapal’s tireless work, the ban could’ve had the votes to pass. We need more progressives in office like her, who will do whatever it takes to fight for a better, fairer, and more transparent Congress.
**[We need Democrats who will stand up to the establishment and push the needle forward on critical issues just like this ban. Your donation will power our work as we organize to elect new Justice Democrats on Nov 8 – will you chip in now?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117004?refcode=em20221005-25427&t=1&akid=25427%2E1203867%2Ei1IOrH)**
**[Contribute](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117004?refcode=em20221005-25427&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=20&akid=25427%2E1203867%2Ei1IOrH)**
This ban is a fair, straightforward, common-sense reform. It should be easy for Democratic leaders to give it their stamp of approval – because it’s overwhelmingly popular:
**63% of ALL voters support banning members of Congress from trading stocks.**
Nancy Pelosi, one of the richest people in Congress, and Steny Hoyer, who has been openly hostile toward the ban from the start, have gutted our last chance to vote on it before the elections.
Once again, corporate Democrats have proved that they care more about personal interest than representing everyday Americans who make up the 99%.
**[We’re here to elect Democrats of a different kind – progressives who we’ll send to Congress to fight for lifesaving policies, not their own wallets. Can we count on your donation as we go all out before Election Day?](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/117004?refcode=em20221005-25427&t=21&akid=25427%2E1203867%2Ei1IOrH)**
In solidarity,
Justice Democrats

Seriously! Join us on October 9 for a can’t-miss VEEP / West Wing Reunion!
| Hi there - the casts of West Wing and Veep are coming together for a one-time livestream crossover event to support the Democratic Party of Wisconsin - _and it 's going to be a ton of fun._ [**Please: split any amount between the Democratic Party of Wisconsin and Voter Protection Project to join us on October 9 for what 's bound to be a wildly hilarious event »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28524?t=6&akid=4809%2E878179%2ET46aUb) [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28524?t=7&akid=4809%2E878179%2ET46aUb) | [SPLIT $10 NOW »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/28524?t=8&akid=4809%2E878179%2ET46aUb)
